title: Senior Business Operations and Growth Lead
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Chief Business Officer organization drives company-wide growth and global expansion. 

This is the role that turns Airbnb's ambition for the UKI & Nordics into a plan and holds the organisation to delivering it: shaping strategy, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving sustainable commercial growth across one of our most important regions.

This includes recruiting and supporting high-quality Stays, Experiences, and Services, alongside executing Airbnb’s global market strategy. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.

The Difference You Will Make

You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.

A Typical Day

You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.

Regional growth strategy

• Own the UKI & Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.

• Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.

• Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.

• Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.

• Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.

• Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.

Operating rhythm and execution

• Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.

• Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.

• Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.

• Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.

• Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.

Cross-functional leadership

• Act as the connective tissue between the UKI & Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.

• Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.

• Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.

• Represent UKI & Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.

• Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.

Insights and storytelling

• Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.

• Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.

• Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.

• Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.

Your Expertise

To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:

• 12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit

• Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution 

• Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation

• Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership

• Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership

• Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates

• Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience

Additional

• Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech

• Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market

• This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range
£126,000—£158,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Creative Director, Marketing
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. 

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Director to set the creative vision for Duolingo’s brand building and marketing efforts and lead a team that delivers culturally resonant, high‑impact work across campaigns, social, partnerships, and user acquisition. You will raise the creative bar, turn bold ideas into clear concepts, and guide execution from brief through launch—collaborating closely with Brand Marketing and Growth, International Marketing, Product, Design, BD, and global agency partners to build an iconic brand with measurable business impact. Reporting to the Head of Brand Marketing, this role will lead other creative leaders in the Marketing function.

🧠 You will...

• Drive all creative work in the Marketing function, ensuring it consistently ladders up to the company strategy and moves key brand and business metrics.

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of creatives; set a high bar for craft, narrative, and taste while creating space for diverse voices and experimentation.

• Turn great ideas into end‑to‑end campaign concepts; guide direction across channels (social, video, experiential, partnerships), from insight to execution.

• Partner with Brand Marketing to shape briefs, make strategic trade‑offs, and deliver work that’s part of culture and drives brand love and growth.

• Partner with Growth Marketing to build a performance marketing creative studio enabling our user acquisition efforts across the globe. 

• Partner with our Country Marketing team to lead and evolve our global agency roster; ensure scopes, standards, and handoffs produce A+ creative worldwide.

• Oversee creative feedback and quality across all project stages; provide clear, timely decisions that keep momentum without sacrificing excellence.

• Inspire the organization with industry trends, creative references, and new platforms; codify what’s “on‑brand” and how we measure brand success.

✅ You have...

• Experience in brand/creative roles with significant time leading other creative leaders; proven success shipping integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets at a high bar.

• Demonstrated ability to set vision, influence senior stakeholders, and connect creative decisions to strategy, KPIs, and ROI.

• A track record of turning insights into iconic, culture‑driving ideas and guiding multi‑disciplinary teams from concept to launch.

• Excellent communication and feedback skills; you simplify complex topics, make fast, sound calls, and bring others along.

• Experience managing agencies and external partners across markets, with a reputation for raising quality and speed.

• The ability to work from or relocate to New York City or London, UK

⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

• Experience working with IP-led brands

• Global brand experience, including creative leadership across multiple regions and cultures.

• A portfolio demonstrating world‑class craft and storytelling— work that drives buzz and earned media attention instead of relying on paid channels for distribution.

• Deep familiarity with social media and creator ecosystems, and how to translate cultural signals into breakthrough brand ideas.

• Experience establishing clear creative operating mechanisms with marketing, product, and design partners.

The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

£150,300—£225,400 GBP

title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager - Cloud & Channel
description:
Datadog’s Partner Marketing Team is looking for a Senior Partner Marketing Manager to drive strategic marketing initiatives with our Cloud Service Providers and Channel Partners in EMEA. In this role, you will own and execute marketing programs designed to increase partner engagement, generate leads, and expand awareness of Datadog’s solutions within the cloud provider and channel ecosystem. This position offers a high-impact opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership while shaping Datadog’s presence with our ecosystem of partners.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Develop and execute regional partner marketing programs, including webinars, demand generation campaigns, enablement sessions, industry events, and social media initiatives to drive engagement.

• Set cross-team strategy and execute plans, working cross-functionally across product, demand gen, and partnerships teams — often in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

• Drive coordinated field alignment, co-sell motions, and partner-led pipeline with AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure

• Understand and work within regions and stakeholders across the South EMEA region to build the partner ecosystem 

• Track and analyze the effectiveness of partner marketing initiatives, reporting on key performance metrics through internal and external quarterly OKRs to ensure continuous optimization.

• Translate partnership data into clear ROI narratives for leadership and client/partner audiences.This includes presenting partnership marketing strategies and results to stakeholders while demonstrating clear ROI and strategic value

• Build and own our EMEA presence at global conferences like AWS Reinvent, DASH and Google Cloud Next 

Who You Are:

• 6-8 years of experience working in marketing; partner marketing and/or high-tech B2B marketing preferred

• Fluent in English (Datadog’s business language). Italian, Spanish or Arabic are nice to have.

• Strong stakeholder management and executive-level communication skills - the ability to build trust and influence across internal teams and partner organizations of varying sizes and seniority.

• You have a track record of turning co-marketing programs into pipeline - past campaigns generated measurable marketing-sourced revenue

• You are a strategic and analytical thinker paired with hands-on execution — you are equally comfortable setting vision and rolling up sleeves to run campaigns.

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to influence others

• You have experience with Salesforce or similar CRM tools

• Comfortable utilising AI in daily work

• This role requires 3 days a week in office

• Ability to travel 20% of the time

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

title: Senior Product Manager - Application Performance Monitoring
description:
At Datadog, we're on a mission to build the best platform in the world for engineers to understand and scale their systems, applications, and teams. We operate at high scale, enabling seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops, and Security teams globally for tens of thousands of companies. Our engineering culture values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity to solve hard problems the right way.

APM at Datadog is on its way to redefine how users interact with their telemetry. We are integrating intelligence directly into troubleshooting workflows to help engineers find root causes faster, navigate complex distributed systems seamlessly, and optimize application performance with minimal cognitive load. APM provides deep visibility from end-user interactions to backend services and we are now expanding this foundation with new AI-driven insights, guidance, and automation.

As a Senior Product Manager for APM, you will own product strategy and drive execution across Distributed Tracing, Performance Analysis, and Intelligent Troubleshooting. You will set direction for a critical area of the roadmap, work closely with senior engineering and design leadership, and influence how APM evolves across the broader observability platform. You'll be relied on to make sound, independent product judgment calls with limited oversight, mentor other product managers, and represent APM in cross-org and executive conversations.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What you will Do:

• Own the product strategy and long-term vision for a core area of APM, grounded in deep understanding of customers, their performance challenges, telemetry workflows, and the competitive landscape

• Lead strategic conversations with design partners and key customers to uncover complex performance issues, validate product bets, and guide solutions from early prototypes through General Availability

• Define and drive delivery of the next generation of APM features with engineering and design leadership, especially agentic onboarding and the out-of-the-box experience, AI-driven troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis

• Make complex performance data, traces, and systems behavior understandable and actionable, even for engineers who are new to observability

• Set direction across engineering, design, and partner PM teams by framing ambiguous problems clearly, driving alignment on trade-offs, and delivering seamless cross-product experiences and unified investigative workflows

• Partner with marketing, sales, customer success, support, and other cross-functional groups to define and lead Go-To-Market strategy for your product area

• Mentor and provide guidance to other product managers, raising the bar for product craft and customer-centric thinking across the team

• Own adoption, retention, and business impact metrics for your product area, and communicate progress and strategy to senior leadership and executives

Who you are:

• You have +5 years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally working on a developer-focused SaaS or infrastructure product, with a track record of owning a product area end to end

• You have experience leading production-level AI projects, from conception through launch and iteration, ideally involving ML-driven insights, automated workflows, or intelligent guidance in complex systems

• You have prior engineering experience or deep expertise in modern software development and distributed systems

• You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and are comfortable presenting to and influencing senior and executive stakeholders

• You are highly customer-focused, detail-oriented, and committed to high quality standards

• You thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments and enjoy both scaling mature products and building new ones from the ground up

• You have experience mentoring or informally guiding other product managers

• You enjoy using AI to explore ideas, quickly prototype, and validate with customers to shape the roadmap

• Bonus: Experience with cloud applications, distributed tracing, performance analysis, microservices, or profiling technologies; fluency in programming languages

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

title: Manager, Artists Label & Partnerships
description:
We are looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artist & Label Partnerships Manager for France, to join Spotify’s Music team based in Paris. In this role, you will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.
 
Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape. 
 


What You'll do 
• Focusing on the French music landscape, you will be the primary point of contact for local music partners based in France, ensuring that Spotify remains the most valued partner for artists and our industry partners, utilising on-platform promotion and off-platform initiatives to ensure Spotify is the premiere platform for artist development

• Support and educate our key partners across artists and labels communities in France on Spotify tools, resources and insights to encourage them and improve their daily business

• You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, executing on creative and cross-functional collaborations in the region and beyond, building impactful and innovative artist partnerships to enable artists development and artist-fan engagement

• You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local FR team to execute pivotal initiatives, multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, consumer marketing, communications, strategy & operations…

• Lead artist & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets

• Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in France and use this to further Spotify's appeal to existing and new users

• Connect other Spotify teams with the music industry to help drive and execute opportunities driven by Spotify and our partners. You will act as liaison between Spotify and artist / label partners.

Who You Are 
• You have significant experience with label and artist relations in an established digital music service, record label, media or tech company. 

• You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in France and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community

• You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify's role in the music industry both locally and globally

• You are skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support strategic decisions and build clear narratives

• You are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements and audience behaviour beyond just data

• You have excellent negotiating, presentation and people skills. You are able to prepare and deliver executive level presentations, effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in with ease

• You are well organised and detail-oriented with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail

• You are at ease and have proven experience navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Music priorities

• You have strong project management skills with a consistent record in marketing and operations, and feel at ease with digital and AI tools

• You possess a perfect level of written and spoken English 

• Finally, you're a great teammate and always have a positive and humble attitude.

Where You'll Be
• For this role, the preferred locations is Paris. 

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

Lead artist & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets

title: Principal Product Manager - Audio and Media Playback
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
We are looking for a Principal Product Manager who will join the Play Product Area within the Core Experience Studio to help evolve the experience of audio and media playback on Spotify. You will help define and evolve the experiences that make playing on Spotify more engaging, rewarding, and valuable for users, creators, and Spotify. Above all, your work will impact how hundreds of millions users experience music and media.


What You'll Do
• 
Work with a cross-functional team that looks after our audio playback capabilities

• 
Work with engineering, design, data science and user research to ensure the experience is scalable, usable, and useful for a range of strategies

• 
Lead multiple projects across the entire product lifecycle

• 
Triangulate data and insights to develop a robust product strategy and inform decision-making as well as short- and long-term roadmaps

• 
Manage cross-functional and cross-org relationships to keep teams and leaders informed, receive input, and influence their thinking

Who You Are
• 
You are an experienced product manager with the ability to work with cross-functional teams, lead complex projects across multiple strategies and stakeholders, and make data-driven decisions

• 
You are an expert in audio experiences, with a strong understanding of both the engineering aspects of audio processing and editing, as well as their impact on the user listening experience. For example, you understand how features like crossfading and beatmatching influence the flow and feel of an audio session, while also ensuring high overall audio quality

• 
Experience from developing video playback experiences (in addition to audio) is a plus; e.g. low-latency video delivery, DRM, and optimizing playback for improved QoE

• 
You have led the product work of several products in large tech companies that you can tell us about

• 
You have a deep understanding of product practices and know how to incorporate multiple different perspectives (including user research, data and strategy) into one single product vision and experience

• 
You care about creating engaging, rewarding, and valuable experiences for users, creators, and Spotify

Where You'll Be
• This role is based in Stockholm or London.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Work with engineering, design, data science and user research to ensure the experience is scalable, usable, and useful for a range of strategies
Lead multiple projects across the entire product lifecycle

title: Principal Product Manager - Content Platform
description:
Content Platform is the foundation of Spotify’s experiences. We ensure our vast catalog of music, podcasts, audiobooks, video, and creator data is trusted, safe, and ready to power innovation across Spotify.
Our work spans content governance, platform safety, metadata, and machine learning systems that enable experiences such as Music Quiz, Playlist Mixes, Save to Spotify and SongDNA. Every day, our platform helps teams across Spotify build better products for millions of listeners and creators. 
As a Principal Product Managers you will own strategy directly. In this role, you’ll shape long-term direction, partner closely with engineering, machine learning, design, and business leaders, and deliver platform capabilities that have company-wide impact.


What You'll Do
• Define and evolve product strategy for your domain using customer insights, data, and long-term platform thinking.

• Lead complex product initiatives from early discovery through delivery in partnership with engineering, machine learning, data science, and design teams.

• Partner with machine learning engineers to shape model strategy, training data, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop systems.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across Spotify to align priorities, influence roadmaps, and drive platform investments that create lasting value.

• Make thoughtful product decisions by balancing customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform health.

• Champion platform safety, trust, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence as Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow.

• Help teams prioritize work that delivers the greatest long-term impact while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes.

• Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress clearly across technical and executive audiences.

Who You Are
• You thrive in highly autonomous environments and enjoy turning ambiguity into clear product direction.

• You have extensive experience leading product strategy and large cross-functional initiatives in complex environments, delivering measurable customer or business impact.

• You make thoughtful product decisions and clearly communicate the reasoning, trade-offs, and outcomes behind them.

Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.
Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.
Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.

In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.


What You'll Do
• Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain.

• Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents.

• Identify and prioritize the highest-impact problems to solve, balancing user needs, business priorities, platform requirements, and regulatory considerations.

• Evaluate and deliver solutions through building, buying, or integrating third-party products and capabilities.

• Define success metrics and KPIs that measure adoption, value creation, and business impact.

• Build strong relationships with internal product, engineering, analytics, and data teams to understand workflows, gather feedback, and shape future platform investments.

• Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and data science partners to deliver high-quality platform experiences.

• Influence stakeholders across the Data Platform Studio and broader Spotify organization to align around product direction and priorities.

• Help shape how Spotify approaches metadata, governance, discoverability, lineage, and trust in an increasingly AI-driven world.

• Stay informed on industry trends across data platforms, developer tools, AI/ML infrastructure, analytics, and data governance.

Who You Are
• You have 2+ years of Product Management experience, ideally working on platform products, developer tools, data infrastructure, analytics platforms, or data governance systems.

• You have a technical foundation through a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, and/or prior experience in engineering or technical roles.

• You are comfortable working with engineers and can engage in technical discussions while representing customer and business needs.

• You are an excellent communicator and collaborator who can build alignment across teams with different priorities and levels of technical expertise.

title: Senior Product Manager - User Platform

title: Product Manager, E-Invoicing
description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy.

About the role

Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have.

We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience.

This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market.

What you'll do

• Own the e-invoicing product vision and roadmap, translating complex and evolving regulatory requirements into a coherent multi-year strategy

• Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines

• Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality

• Define and own the end-to-end user journey: from onboarding (including business identity verification) to live invoice transmission via certified networks like Peppol

• Work closely with the Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Connect teams to embed e-invoicing as a native part of Stripe's financial infrastructure — not a bolted-on feature

• Establish quality, reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement

• Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to position Stripe as the leading e-invoicing solution for upmarket and enterprise customers

• Represent Stripe credibly with regulators, certification bodies, and industry partners as we build direct relationships with key tax authorities and networks

Who you are

Required

• 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain

• Deep familiarity with the e-invoicing landscape — you understand CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America

• Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture

• Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into concrete roadmap decisions

• Experience launching products across multiple markets simultaneously, including navigating localization, regulatory compliance, and differing user needs

• Excellent cross-functional leadership — you get things done across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM without formal authority

• Clear, direct communication: you can distill a complex compliance landscape into a compelling product narrative for both internal stakeholders and external audiences

Nice to have

• Experience integrating third-party technology providers or acquisitions into a core product platform

• Familiarity with Stripe Billing, Invoicing, or Tax products

• Prior experience building toward Peppol access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF)

• Exposure to B2B invoicing workflows in mid-market or enterprise contexts

Why this role, why now

E-invoicing is one of the most consequential shifts in global business compliance in a decade, and Stripe is early in building the infrastructure to make it effortless. You'll have the mandate, the resources, and the cross-functional backing to build something significant — and the chance to make Stripe synonymous with world-class e-invoicing.

Stripe is an equal opportunity employer. We look for people with exceptional abilities, who are excited by hard problems and big opportunities.

Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines
Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality

title: Product Manager, Foreign Exchange
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, manage their businesses, and grow their revenue. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. You’ll have an opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach. 

About the team

The Foreign Exchange team builds the products and infrastructure that help Stripe users operate across currencies. Businesses increasingly operate globally from the moment they launch, collecting revenue, holding balances, paying suppliers, and managing expenses across multiple currencies.

Managing those currencies remains fragmented. Finance teams must decide what to hold, when to convert, how to manage currency exposure, and how to reconcile the results. Today, these workflows often span banks, spreadsheets, treasury systems, and specialist FX providers.

Stripe is uniquely positioned to simplify this. We sit at the center of the payments, Billing, balances, payouts, and settlement flows that create a business’s currency needs. Our vision is to make Stripe the financial home for businesses operating internationally, with a unified offering for holding, converting, and managing currencies and FX risk.

A core part of this vision is making currency management agentic. We believe software agents will increasingly help businesses understand their FX position, recommend actions, and manage currencies within defined policies and controls.

This could include Stripe-native agents that monitor exposure and take approved actions. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s infrastructure to understand balances and exposures, obtain pricing, execute conversions or hedges, and reconcile the results.

Our goal is to make Stripe the currency-management layer that both people and agents can build on.

We will build these capabilities both for globally operating businesses and for the platforms and marketplaces that use Connect.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Product Manager to build a new area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering. This is a zero-to-one product role at the intersection of FX, treasury, and agentic AI. You will help define what agentic currency management should look like. That could mean Stripe-native agents that understand exposure, recommend actions, and execute within customer-defined policies. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s FX infrastructure to understand balances, obtain pricing, manage risk, execute transactions, and reconcile the results.

You will work directly with globally operating businesses to understand their most important currency-management problems. You will identify the right initial product wedge and take it from discovery through launch and iteration. Today, treasury teams assemble exposures from multiple systems, determine hedge requirements, monitor changing positions, request pricing, execute trades, and reconcile the results. We believe much of this workflow can become continuous, intelligent, and increasingly automated.

You might build products that combine Stripe’s real-time view of payments, balances, and settlement activity with customer forecasts and policies to identify exposures and recommend actions. You might also define the APIs, permissions, controls, and financial primitives that allow customer or third-party agents to safely take those actions through Stripe.

Over time, these systems could move from surfacing insights to requesting quotes, executing conversions or hedges, rebalancing positions, and escalating exceptions within clearly defined permissions.

You will determine which intelligence Stripe should provide directly, which capabilities we should expose for others to build on, where humans should remain in the decision loop, and how we evaluate whether agents are making good decisions. Your product area could also include automated conversion and balance policies, recurring currency-management workflows, or capabilities distributed through Connect.

The opportunity is broad. Your job will be to make it focused. You will determine where Stripe can create differentiated value, build the first product, measure whether it works, and use those learnings to shape the roadmap.

You will work closely with Engineering and Design on product experiences, APIs, data models, agent behavior, controls, and system reliability. You will also partner with Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure the products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and ready for customers.

Responsibilities

• Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.

• Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering.

• Identify high-value customer problems and take new products from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

• Define Stripe’s approach to agentic currency management, including Stripe-native experiences, agent-ready APIs, permissions, controls, and evaluation.

• Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build simple, reliable products across user experiences, APIs, data models, and financial infrastructure.

• Work across Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and successful with customers.

• Use customer insights and product results to shape Stripe’s broader FX and currency-management strategy.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of product management experience, including taking technically complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.

• Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategies and focused roadmaps.

• Experience building financial infrastructure, enterprise software, APIs, regulated products, AI-native products, or similarly complex systems.

• Strong technical judgment and experience partnering with engineers on APIs, data flows, reliability, and system behavior.

• Strong customer instincts and experience translating complex financial or operational workflows into simple, scalable products.

• Strong analytical judgment and ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

• Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain product decisions, risks, and tradeoffs across technical and nontechnical teams.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with foreign exchange, multi-currency products, treasury, cross-border money movement, hedging, or financial risk management.

• Experience building AI-native or agentic products, especially systems that can recommend or take actions within defined controls.

• Experience building products for finance or treasury teams at globally operating businesses.

• Experience with API-first, configurable, or automated financial products.

• Familiarity with the economics, accounting, liquidity, regulatory, or operational considerations involved in FX products.

duties: Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.
Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering.
Identify high-value customer problems and take new products from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Seller Experience & Insights team is responsible for ensuring Stripe’s Go-to-Market teams have the tools, systems, processes and policies they need to sell effectively. We identify friction in how sellers get work done, translate seller needs into scalable solutions and partner across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales Operations and Enablement to improve productivity and the quality of Stripe’s customer engagement.

What you’ll do

Stripe is evolving how Sales Development Representatives identify, engage and qualify prospective users. Agentic workflows can remove repetitive work and help SDRs focus their time on judgement-rich customer conversations. Realising that value requires more than introducing new tools: it requires a coherent end-to-end experience across targeting, outreach, task execution, lead handoff, follow-up, qualification and reporting.

You will own the business experience and improvement roadmap for Stripe’s SDR workflows. You will work closely with SDRs and their leaders to understand how work happens today, identify the highest-value sources of friction and shape tools, processes and policies that make the organisation more effective. Your initial coverage will be Stripe’s agentic outreach solution and Gong Engage, including how these capabilities interact with Salesforce, Orum, Gmail, LinkedIn and supporting routing and data services. Over time, the remit may expand to other parts of the SDR tooling and workflow ecosystem.

You will act as the connective tissue between frontline sellers and the teams that build and operate these capabilities. You will turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, prioritised roadmaps, measurable launches and continuously improving workflows.

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end SDR experience roadmap across account and contact sourcing, targeting, outreach, task execution, handraiser management, meeting disposition and qualification.

• Lead the business product and operational strategy for Stripe’s agentic outreach solution and Gong Engage within Sales Development, ensuring agentic and seller-led workflows solve meaningful seller problems and fit coherently into the broader SDR operating model.

• Own the experience across the hand-offs between Stripe’s agentic outreach solution and Gong Engage, including cadence creation, SDR task execution, prospect responses, meeting hand-offs and downstream activity capture.

• Map current workflows and redesign them to reduce manual work, duplicate actions, context switching and avoidable failure points across SDR tools and systems.

• Establish scalable mechanisms to capture, synthesise and prioritise SDR and manager feedback, combining qualitative insight with product usage, workflow, support and pipeline data.

• Translate frontline needs into clear business requirements, user journeys, success criteria and prioritised recommendations for Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales Systems and Operations partners.

• Define and monitor the metrics that matter across productivity, adoption, workflow health, data quality, follow-up speed, pipeline quality and prospect experience.

• Partner with Sales Development leadership, Sales Operations and policy owners to ensure tooling and workflow design reflects routing, territory, rules-of-engagement and qualification requirements.

• Build launch and change-management plans with Enablement and Communications so that new capabilities are understood, adopted and embedded in daily SDR work.

• Create governance and operating rhythms for agentic workflows, including release readiness, feedback triage, incident escalation, experiment review and post-launch iteration.

• Identify opportunities to simplify or consolidate the SDR tooling landscape and develop evidence-based business cases for investment, deprecation or process change.

• Represent the SDR experience in cross-functional planning and communicate trade-offs, progress, risks and results clearly to frontline teams and senior leaders.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3-5+ years of experience in program management, product operations, revenue operations, sales operations, product management or process improvement in a technology or high-growth environment.

• 2+ years of experience building, improving or supporting Sales Development or broader GTM workflows, data and systems.

• Demonstrated success leading complex, global and cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through launch, adoption and iteration.

• Strong understanding of how modern prospecting and sales-development workflows operate, including targeting, contact sourcing, outreach, lead routing, qualification and CRM activity capture.

• Ability to map complex user journeys, identify root causes and translate ambiguous seller problems into clear requirements and prioritised solutions.

• Strong analytical skills, including the ability to define success metrics, interpret workflow and funnel data and use evidence to make trade-offs.

• Experience partnering effectively with technical teams and communicating across frontline, operational, product and executive audiences.

• A proactive, low-ego and hands-on working style, with comfort moving between strategy and detailed execution in a rapidly changing environment.

• Strong change-management skills and a track record of driving adoption, not just delivering a launch.

Preferred qualifications

• Direct experience in Sales Development, SDR Operations or the design of SDR productivity programs.

• Familiarity with Salesforce and sales-engagement, conversation-intelligence, dialing, enrichment or routing platforms such as Gong, Orum, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable tools.

• Experience designing or operating AI-assisted or agentic workflows, including human-in-the-loop controls, quality measurement and responsible-use guardrails.

• Experience with experimentation, funnel analysis, SQL or business-intelligence tools.

• A strong understanding of data quality, routing, rules of engagement and the downstream effects of workflow changes on reporting and seller incentives.

• Experience developing enablement, documentation or operating mechanisms for global sales teams.

• A passion for understanding seller behaviour and improving both employee and prospective-user experiences.

title: Regional Marketing Manager, DACH
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic, fast-growing group that loves turning customers into enthusiastic Stripe advocates. We work hand-in-hand with our Sales team to build demand, help users get the most out of our products, and craft marketing plans that truly resonate with local audiences. 

In the DACH region, our team partners with some of the most ambitious innovators across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland—brands like DeepL, refurbed, N26, and Nestlé. We help them use Stripe’s financial infrastructure to unlock new revenue, navigate local complexities, and scale globally. What we learn from these relationships directly influences how Stripe builds its products. The opportunity in this region is massive. We’re tackling it as a diverse, international team that thrives on collaboration, bold innovation, and genuine curiosity. If you love to learn and want to make a meaningful impact, we'd love to have you join us.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead marketing strategy and plan execution for the DACH region and serve as the primary Marketing partner on the DACH Leadership Team. You’ll set the regional strategy and investment plan, with Germany as the main market, and shape priorities across Austria and Switzerland. You’ll be accountable for demand, pipeline, customer advocacy, and Stripe’s long-term market position in the region.

As a senior individual contributor, you will align regional and global cross-functional teams around shared priorities, secure the necessary resources, and navigate trade-offs between global strategies and local market needs. You will directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.

Leveraging deep market and account insights, you will identify key growth opportunities across target industries and audiences. In close partnership with Sales, you will build tailored programs for strategic accounts and high-potential prospects aligned with their business models, technical environments, and commercial objectives.

Responsibilities

• Define and own the integrated DACH marketing strategy, turning business goals, market dynamics, and competitive context into clear priorities.

• Partner with DACH GTM leadership, Sales, Sales Development, and Partnerships to set shared priorities, join business and pipeline reviews, and focus investment on the highest-value opportunities.

• Build and oversee a full-funnel DACH marketing plan across brand, demand generation, account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration, executive engagement, and customer advocacy.

• Develop industry and account programs for strategic customers and high-potential prospects, helping Sales engage the right stakeholders with relevant messages.

• Bring together EMEA and global teams, including Demand Generation and Product Marketing, to deliver the DACH plan, working with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Communications.

• Build Stripe’s brand and local presence in DACH through regional customer stories, partner programs, and executive, industry, and ecosystem engagement, including activation around Stripe flagship and third-party events.

• Own metrics across demand, pipeline, opportunity progression, priority-account engagement, and return on investment. Use results to improve programs and stop or change those that aren’t delivering.

• Represent DACH across EMEA and global marketing teams, bringing market insight into planning and sharing successful programs across markets.

Who you are

You’re an experienced B2B marketer who has owned a country, regional, or similarly broad marketing strategy. You can set direction, make investment trade-offs, and work credibly with senior Sales and GTM leaders. You stay close enough to execution to turn the strategy into commercial results.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including ownership of planning and investment for a country, region, or comparably broad portfolio in enterprise technology or another complex B2B environment.

• Deep understanding of the German and wider DACH business and technology markets, including enterprise buying dynamics and local ecosystems.

• Proven record of partnering with senior Sales and GTM leaders and aligning cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Experience leading integrated programs across several marketing disciplines, drawing on regional and global specialist teams.

• Ownership of annual budgets and multi-program portfolios, with evidence of using commercial results to prioritize investment.

• Fluency in German and English, with the ability to explain technical concepts and present complex strategies to executive audiences.

• Sound judgment and comfort making decisions when priorities compete or information is incomplete.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in payments, financial technology, commerce, B2B cloud services, or another complex and highly competitive technology category.

• Experience engaging enterprise executives and buying groups across Finance, Treasury, Technology, Product, and Operations.

• A track record of building local brand relevance, thought leadership, customer advocacy, or influence strategies—not only demand-generation programs.

• Experience building a marketing approach where the playbook, resources, or route to impact was still taking shape.

Partner with DACH GTM leadership, Sales, Sales Development, and Partnerships to set shared priorities, join business and pipeline reviews, and focus investment on the highest-value opportunities.
Build and oversee a full-funnel DACH marketing plan across brand, demand generation, account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration, executive engagement, and customer advocacy.

title: Risk Partnerships Manager, Banks & Treasury
description:
Who we are 

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk Partnerships team is an essential part of Stripe’s Global Partnerships organization. Our team is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with key partner banks to manage risk for Stripe’s business activities. These banking partnerships are essential to enable Stripe to accept and make payments, provide credit, move & store money and develop new products and solutions to meet our users’ needs. We work across a broad range of risk and compliance topics including; credit, fraud, regulatory, financial crime, reputational, product and operational risks.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a new team member to collaborate with key banking partners throughout the UK, Europe and Stripe’s global partner network. These partners will work with Stripe to develop and deliver solutions that will build our Global Payments and Treasury Network. This role will support Stripe's goals to enable users to send and receive payments domestically and internationally, store funds securely, earn yield on those funds, and enable multi-currency fund flows.

Risk management is essential for managing these relationships, and this role requires a broad understanding of risk disciplines across banking activities, including accepting and making payments, money storage & transmission, and multi-currency/cross border fund flow.

This role will lead activities to enhance risk management interactions between Stripe and its partners, manage key aspects of the partner relationships, and execute high-impact initiatives.

This role will work closely with key internal and external stakeholders to set objectives, coordinate priorities and drive execution. Internally, this role will coordinate closely with product and engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders including Risk, Fraud, Financial Crime & Supportability, Operations, Legal and Finance. Externally, this role will work closely with Partners' Risk & Compliance teams, including senior management.

Responsibilities

• Lead risk-focused initiatives in collaboration with global financial partners (banks, networks, payment methods) to:

• Foster new business opportunities and user verticals

• Innovate on shared risk methodologies

• Establish and maintain compliance with agreed risk appetites

• Oversee and maintain the health of relationships with key risk counterparts at partner banks

• Develop and manage projects and initiatives that support strong partner relationships regarding risk

• Deliver business and policy recommendations that inform our risk posture

• Act as a representative and negotiator of our risk approach to banking partners

• Enhance existing and develop new partner-facing risk management capabilities

• Lead risk-related partnership and product discussions with banking partners to align on risk approaches and strategies

• Identify and pursue business opportunities by creating innovative risk-aware solutions that expand our product and user base through banking partnership

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years experience in risk-related role at a bank or fintech with experience of products & services that enabled users to send and receive payments domestically and internationally, store funds securely, earn yield on those funds, and enable multi-currency fund flows.

• Demonstrated deep knowledge and experience of working with bank payment schemes and networks (e.g. FPS, BACs, SEPA, ACH and local equivalents)

• A deep knowledge of risk and compliance issues.

• Ability to represent Stripe on risk, compliance, and product issues with banking partners to maintain positive relationships.

• Strong organizational, planning, and communication skills (written and verbal) to drive understanding, collaboration, and issue resolution.

• Curiosity and a partnership mindset focused on improving processes and scaling solutions.

• First-hand experience in risk management at a bank or fintech

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including navigating difficult situations, negotiating timelines, and influencing stakeholders across organizations and borders.

• Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to thrive in uncertain and ambiguous environments.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience of financial crime programmes including; KYC/B, AML, Sanctions and Terrorist Financing, with a practical knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering regulations.

• A deep understanding of domestic & international payment schemes (e.g. FPS, CHAPS, BACs, SEPA, ACH, Wire).

• Strong understanding of the complex risks that are present when managing crossborder payments, including the management of high risk sectors.

• Market experience across UK & Europe, with an understanding of how current and future regulations will impact Stripe and it’s banking partners.

• Experience of leveraging technology to support the development and embedment of scalable risk and operational processes.

About Us

At Stripe, we're building a financial system for the internet. We're hiring talented people like you to help us make this vision a reality.

duties: Lead risk-focused initiatives in collaboration with global financial partners (banks, networks, payment methods) to:
Foster new business opportunities and user verticals
Innovate on shared risk methodologies

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Risk
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business models. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing some of the most important work of your career. You can read more about the business we’re building and what we’re looking forward to in our annual letter.

About the team

The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.

Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.

At Stripe’s scale—$1.9T in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Staff Product Manager for Risk, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.

You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.

You will partner closely with Risk leadership to shape the organization’s strategy, vision, and most important investments. As a senior member of Stripe’s product community, you will also coach other PMs, raise the quality of product thinking across Risk, and advance the product management discipline across Stripe.

Responsibilities

• Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.

• Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.

• Lead changes to Risk’s approach to leveraging data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.

• Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and ML leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.

• Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively, while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.

• Partner with Risk leadership to define multi-year strategy, identify the organization’s most important bets, and make clear investment and sequencing decisions.

• Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolving difficult tradeoffs and driving progress without relying on formal authority.

• Coach and mentor PMs across Risk, helping them strengthen their product judgment, technical depth, strategic thinking, and execution.

• Advance the product management discipline across Stripe by raising the bar for how we define problems, develop strategy, partner with technical teams, and deliver complex cross-organizational work.

Who you are

We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.

You move fluently from defining multi-year strategy to driving the details of execution. You build alignment and lead transformational work across teams without direct management authority. You earn trust through the clarity of your thinking, your focus on users, and your hands-on engagement in the work. You raise the ambition and effectiveness of the teams and PMs around you without needing to manage them.

Minimum requirements

• A track record of identifying and delivering high-impact, transformational product or technical initiatives that span multiple teams and organizations.

• Demonstrated ability to bring clarity to deeply ambiguous problems, set a compelling direction, and drive work through execution and adoption.

• Strong technical judgment across data, machine learning, AI, APIs, platforms, and system architecture.

• Experience partnering deeply with senior engineering, data science, and product leaders to shape both technical direction and product strategy.

• Strong product judgment across foundational infrastructure and user-facing experiences, with a focus on building capabilities that solve real user problems.

• Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to use data and causal reasoning to understand problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure outcomes.

• Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build alignment across organizational boundaries, and drive execution without direct management authority.

• Experience mentoring and developing PMs and raising the quality of product thinking and execution across teams.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies, influence technical and executive audiences, and make complex topics clear.

• High agency, intellectual honesty, curiosity, and a low-ego, hands-on working style.

Preferred qualifications

• An engineering and preferably ML-based technical background.

• Experience applying AI and machine learning to complex, high-stakes problems at scale.

• Experience with fraud, credit, payments, financial services, trust and safety, or another domain involving complex decisions and asymmetric consequences.

• Experience working with globally distributed teams

duties: Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.
Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
Lead changes to Risk’s approach to leveraging data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.
