title: Staff Product Manager, Issuing
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Stripe Issuing team enables users–from the most promising startups and largest platforms in the world to Stripe itself—to build and launch successful card programs and financial features into their product using powerful programmatic APIs and intuitive UIs. The team creates the infrastructure, user facing experiences, and partner integrations needed to manage the lifecycle of a card and enable efficient money movement. This is a great opportunity to help build one of Stripe’s fastest growing businesses. Our top users span fintechs to large enterprises & cover a range of verticals including Buy Now Pay Later, vertical SaaS platforms, on-demand marketplaces, expense management platforms, fleet, travel & more across the world.

What you’ll do

As EMEA Staff Product Manager for Stripe Issuing, you will lead our product development efforts for building the best-in-class card issuance systems, including designing user-facing APIs and interfaces and working directly with top global users in building and growing their card programs in EMEA. This is a highly complex and challenging role that will require you to deeply understand user needs and collaborate across internal and partner teams to build and launch a seamless product experience at scale.

We’re looking for a strong Staff Product Manager that can run Stripe Issuing in EMEA like a standalone business, with expertise in partnering with go-to-market teams to scale our EMEA Issuing business. This Staff Product Manager will spend significant time with users to deeply understand their needs and experiences, Stripe leadership and go-to-market teams to build the EMEA Issuing strategy and roadmap, and cross-functional internal stakeholders to build compliant and scalable products.

Responsibilities

• Lead our Stripe Issuing effort in UK and Europe

• Shape the direction and product strategy for helping users manage their card programs

• Partner with engineering to bring new Stripe Issuing product solutions to the UK and European markets

• Collaborate with other Stripe teams (design, legal, risk, compliance, engineering, etc.) early in the product development lifecycle and jointly shape product plans that lead with delightful and helpful user experiences

• Own the roadmap and go-to-market, with product marketing, of EMEA Stripe Issuing

• Act as the voice of the user in product and API designs, gathering direct feedback from customers

• Ensure we’re building in a scalable, performant way

Who you are

We're looking for someone who:

• Brings 8+ years of experience in a product role

• Has domain knowledge in financial products, particularly card issuing, financial systems, and card networks

• Strong focus on scaling products in close collaboration with go-to-market teams

• Has experience building platform and/or API products

• Has strong written and verbal communication skills with a talent for precise articulations of customer problems

• Can put themselves in the shoes of their users and be a steward of crafting great experiences

duties: Lead our Stripe Issuing effort in UK and Europe
Shape the direction and product strategy for helping users manage their card programs
Partner with engineering to bring new Stripe Issuing product solutions to the UK and European markets

title: Staff Product Manager, Stripe Tax
description:
Stripe is building the economic infrastructure for the internet. Millions of businesses use Stripe to accept payments, manage revenue, and grow globally. Stripe Tax helps businesses calculate, collect, and manage indirect taxes as they sell across products, markets, and business models.

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of Stripe Tax. In this role, you will lead high-impact product strategy and execution across a broad portfolio, making it easier for businesses to understand, calculate, collect, and manage tax as they grow.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Product Manager on Stripe Tax, you will identify the most important opportunities to improve our tax products and turn them into focused strategies, durable platforms, and exceptional user experiences.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Tax, Partnerships, Go-to-Market, and other product teams to:

• Set strategy and lead product initiatives that help more businesses successfully adopt and use Stripe Tax.

• Improve the speed, accuracy, reliability, and usability of Stripe Tax calculations and related workflows.

• Expand support for the geographies, tax requirements, industries, products, and business models that matter most to Stripe users.

• Build capabilities for complex tax needs, such as registrations, exemptions, address and fulfillment logic, tax customization, and other business-specific requirements.

• Develop scalable products and platform capabilities that work across Stripe’s ecosystem, including integrations, connector apps, marketplaces, and Connect platforms.

• Partner across Stripe to create coherent end-to-end experiences spanning calculation, collection, reporting, and tax management.

• Use customer insight, market context, data, and technical understanding to prioritize investments and make clear tradeoffs.

• Align senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners around a shared product direction, measurable outcomes, and an execution plan.

What success looks like

You will help make Stripe Tax a product businesses can rely on as they scale. Merchants should be able to confidently answer “yes” to questions such as:

• Can I use Stripe Tax for my business and the locations where I sell?

• Does Stripe Tax support the taxes and business models that apply to me?

• Can it calculate tax accurately for my registrations, exemptions, customers, products, and fulfillment model?

• Is it fast, reliable, and easy for my team to operate?

• Does it work with the other Stripe products, platforms, and integrations my business depends on?

Who you are

You are a product leader who is comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-stakes spaces where customer needs, regulatory complexity, technical constraints, and commercial opportunity intersect. You can translate a broad mission into a focused strategy, build alignment across teams, and deliver meaningful products over multiple horizons.

You likely have:

• Significant product management experience, including ownership of complex, platform-oriented, or technically deep products.

• A track record of setting strategy and delivering multi-team initiatives with measurable business and customer impact.

• Strong judgment in prioritizing across customer needs, market opportunities, operational complexity, and engineering investment.

• Experience working closely with engineering and design partners to build reliable, scalable products.

• The ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders and to align diverse partners around a shared direction.

• Curiosity about global commerce, financial infrastructure, tax, compliance, payments, marketplaces, or developer platforms. Direct domain experience is helpful but not required.

• A customer-first mindset and the ability to turn complex requirements into simple, effective product experiences.

Why this role

Tax is a fundamental challenge for businesses that sell across borders, channels, and business models. Stripe Tax has the opportunity to remove that complexity, helping businesses launch faster, expand with confidence, and operate globally.

This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of global commerce, financial infrastructure, and product platform strategy. You will shape how Stripe Tax evolves to serve the next generation of internet businesses.

title: Senior Professional, Energy Brand Management, Jordan France
description:
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
 
As part of the France Jordan marketing team, you'll report to the Marketing Director, Jordan Brand France, with a dotted line to the Energy Marketing Director, Jordan Brand EMEA, and work closely with the Lead Professional, Energy Relationship Management, Jordan Brand France. This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration to bring impactful marketing plans to life across the territory and priority marketplace accounts.
 
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
In Jordan Brand, we believe there is greatness in everyone. Our mission is to inspire & unleash personal greatness across every corner of the world and if we do this, we believe we'll unify and elevate our 'community of greatness' to change the world for the better. With our deep roots in basketball, the Jordan Brand began as an homage to one player: Michael Jordan. Since then, Jordan has become synonymous with peak performance and an endless pursuit of greatness.
 
The ideal candidate will be a talented marketeer who is passionate about brand building and creative culture, with a keen understanding of the agitator consumer and the cultural movers operating at the intersection of fashion, streetwear and sport. This person will understand the marketplace, identify the moments and opportunities where Jordan can have disproportionate impact, and turn strategic direction into integrated marketing plans. We seek someone who can lead projects end-to-end, connect brand priorities to Streetwear Specialty accounts (NBHD) and marketplace moments. Balancing creative ambition with disciplined budget and project management.

Key Skills:

• Experience in Cultural marketing, Brand Marketing, Integrated Marketing, or related marketing roles, within a brand or agency environment.

• Demonstrated experience building marketing plans and leading multiple projects across key consumer touchpoints, including retail, digital, social and experiential marketing.

• Fluency in English required.

• Deep interest in fashion, streetwear, sport, art, music, design and subcultures.

• Strong creative judgment and taste level, with the ability to recognize culturally relevant, premium and distinctive ideas and drive high-quality brand execution.

• Proven track record of developing and executing breakthrough brand and cultural marketing campaigns, working with brands, catalysts and collaborators.

• Strong understanding of the French consumer (with a focus on Paris), marketplace and cultural landscape, with the ability to translate local insights into relevant brand opportunities.

• Strategic ability to translate broader brand direction into clear seasonal plans

• Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, agencies, timelines and stakeholders while driving plans through to high-quality execution.

Jordan Brand Attributes:

• Understanding of Jordan Brand's unique history and heritage in basketball culture.

• Core understanding of Jordan Brand's current role in Parisian streetwear culture, including footwear and apparel trends.

• Deep knowledge of basketball and global football relevance to Gen Z and Gen Alpha consumers.

• Authentic connection to fashion, streetwear, basketball, football and creative communities.

• Demonstrated ability to build brand awareness and strength in a global city.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON 

• You will translate EMEA Energy briefs into locally relevant marketing plans and lead the territory execution of Jordan's priority brand moments. Identify consumer and cultural moments that matter locally. You will connect consumer and cultural insights with project leadership and cross-functional orchestration, supporting premium execution across the city (events, experiences, campaign creation) and relevant Streetwear Specialty accounts (NBHD). 

• You will represent Jordan Brand in Paris and France by building seasonal plans, identifying the consumer and cultural moments that matter locally, and orchestrating teams and partners to execute the offense with clarity, creativity and operational excellence. 

Core Responsibilities:

• Territory seasonal plans: develop the Paris/France response to the EMEA brief, from upstream alignment to execution.

• Lead Territory-owned brand projects end-to-end: own local briefs, creative development, agency management, production and delivery against agreed objectives and timelines.

• Support the integrated City offense: connecting Territory Brand, EMEA Energy and key cross-functional partners across Communications, Digital, Media, Sales, Merchandising and Creative to deliver one aligned consumer experience.

• Partner closely with the Relationship Management counterpart to activate the France Energy Jordan family of partners and cultural catalysts, leveraging relationships and cultural insights to develop and deliver locally relevant brand plans.

• Bring local opportunities and consumer insights upstream: identify city-right consumer moments, marketplace opportunities, partners and cultural signals that inform EMEA strategy and future seasonal planning.

• Partner with Streetwear Specialty (NBHD) and Sales to help drive premium Brand execution across priority accounts and marketplace moments: translate account strategy and seasonal Brand priorities into city-right consumer experiences, from brief through final execution, while Streetwear Specialty retains ownership of account strategy.

• Own the Territory Energy budget and spend, including PO creation and management: coordinate closely with the EMEA Energy Brand Director and Jordan France Brand Director to ensure disciplined investment, accurate forecasting and timely spend.Provide local input and support for Global and EMEA team visits and priority moments in Paris specifically.

Local candidates preferred.

title: Lead Professional, Brand Marketing, Football, France
description:
Are you ready to help shape the future of Nike Football in France?
 
As Lead Professional Brand Marketing, Football, you'll play a pivotal role in driving Nike’s football brand strategy across France, with a strong focus on Paris and Marseille.
 
Based in Paris, you'll join the France Country Marketing team, where sport, culture, and community intersect. Your role will bring Nike’s football vision to life through strategic campaigns, powerful storytelling, and locally relevant activations that connect authentically with athletes, consumers, and cultural leaders.
 
You'll adapt global and EMEA campaigns for maximum impact in one of the world’s most influential football markets, ensuring Nike remains at the centre of the game and the culture that surrounds it.
 
As part of your role, you'll also own the marketing relationship for some of Nike’s most high-profile football partnerships, helping to amplify the brand through athletes, clubs, and key moments that inspire the next generation.
 
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
 
In this role, you'll be part of the broader Football Brand team and collaborate closely with functional partners across Sports Marketing, Brand Creative, Retail Marketing, Communications, Energy Marketing, and Social & Community Impact.
You'll work in close partnership with the EMEA Football team and, at times, the Global Football team to ensure consistency, alignment, and impact across the marketplace. You'll also build strong relationships with external partners across the French football ecosystem, including athletes, clubs, federations, and retail accounts.
 
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 
You're a forward-thinking brand marketer with a deep passion for football and a strong understanding of the French football landscape. You know how to transform consumer insights into culturally relevant ideas and compelling storytelling that drives brand connection and business impact.
 
You thrive in collaborative environments, bring energy to every project, and are comfortable navigating complexity while influencing diverse stakeholders.
 
You'll bring:

• A proven track record in brand marketing roles requiring strong cross-functional collaboration.

• Experience in football marketing, with a deep understanding of the French football consumer and cultural landscape.

• Experience working with professional athletes, clubs, or federations, with the ability to build and manage relationships effectively.

• Familiarity with the French football retail environment and experience collaborating with retail partners.

• Demonstrated success leading projects and aligning internal and external teams behind a common vision.

• A strong connection to football culture and an understanding of its influence both on and off the pitch.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive, adaptable mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
 
Reporting to the Director, Brand Marketing Football, France, you'll be responsible for delivering Nike Football’s brand impact across the country.
 
You'll lead the planning and execution of seasonal brand campaigns, from strategic development through to marketplace activation. You'll bring energy, creativity, and precision to product launches, major football moments, and initiatives that keep Nike at the forefront of football culture in France.
 
Your work will connect Nike’s global football vision with local consumer insights, creating experiences and stories that are authentic, meaningful, and culturally relevant. You'll drive cross-functional alignment, cultivate strategic partnerships, and ensure every execution reflects the voice of the French football consumer while staying true to Nike's broader brand direction.
 
Through your leadership, you'll help shape how Nike shows up across football in France, building deeper connections with athletes and fans while driving brand distinction in one of Nike’s most important football markets.

title: Retail Brand Marketing Specialist II, France
description:
Retail Brand Marketing Specialist II, France

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a passionate, creative and consumer-obsessed retail brand marketer to help shape how Nike shows up across its Nike Direct marketplace in France.

You are energised by the intersection of sport, culture, community and retail, and understand how to translate brand strategies into locally relevant consumer experiences. You bring curiosity, agility and a growth mindset, thriving in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve across sport dimensions, including Football, Sportswear, Running, Training and beyond.

You have a deep understanding of Nike’s Young Athlete consumer, as well as the local communities and subcultures that shape and influence them. You are able to gather, connect and consolidate consumer, cultural, sport and marketplace insights, translating them into meaningful recommendations and local plans that build emotional connection with the next generation while creating distinction for Nike across sport.
 
Who You Will Work With

Based in Paris, you will be part of the wider France Integrated Retail Marketing team and report directly to the Retail Brand Manager, Nike Direct France.
You will work closely with cross-functional partners across the France territory and EMEA, including:

• Integrated Retail Marketing, including Retail Brand Wholesale

• Visual Merchandising & Styling

• EKIN, Nike’s product experts

• Brand Marketing

• Communications

• Sports Marketing

• Energy

• Nike Direct and retail teams

You will also partner with EMEA Retail Brand and other relevant EMEA functions to ensure alignment with seasonal strategies, exchange best practices and bring locally relevant insights back into the wider organisation.
Your day-to-day work will vary significantly. You will need to collaborate fluidly across functions, adapt your approach to different stakeholders and remain open to diverse expertise and perspectives to unlock stronger, more integrated consumer experiences.
 
What You Will Work On

You will help bring Nike’s seasonal sport and brand priorities to life across Nike Direct stores in France, translating EMEA strategies into compelling, locally relevant retail experiences.

Working across sport categories, you will support and, when appropriate, lead retail brand initiatives rooted in innovation, product, athlete storytelling, sport and culture. You will help ensure that every consumer touchpoint reflects Nike’s brand standards while responding to the specific needs of the French marketplace, its cities, communities and Young Athlete consumer.

You will contribute to the full journey, from gathering insights and supporting seasonal planning to activation, execution and post-campaign learning, ensuring Nike shows up consistently and distinctively across the Nike Direct fleet.
 
Key Responsibilities

• Support the development of the Nike Direct France retail brand vision, connecting Nike’s brand and sport priorities with relevant marketplace and consumer opportunities.

• Contribute to seasonal planning across Nike Direct, translating key sport, product, innovation, athlete and cultural stories into clear retail priorities and consumer journeys.

• Work with agility across Football, Sportswear, Running, Training and other sport dimensions according to seasonal priorities and business needs.

• Support and, when appropriate, lead the activation of seasonal campaigns, key sporting moments, athlete stories and locally relevant cultural opportunities across Nike Direct stores.

• Adapt EMEA strategies to the French marketplace, ensuring plans are locally relevant while remaining aligned with Nike’s wider brand direction.

• Gather, connect and consolidate consumer, community, cultural, sport and retail insights to identify opportunities and inform local plans.

• Develop a deep understanding of the Young Athlete consumer and of the communities, subcultures and influences shaping the next generation in France.

• Partner closely with Visual Merchandising & Styling and EKIN teams to translate seasonal strategies into impactful and educational retail experiences.

• Collaborate with Retail Brand Wholesale, Brand Marketing, Communications, Sports Marketing and Energy to deliver cohesive and integrated consumer experiences.

• Champion Nike’s brand standards across consumer touchpoints, ensuring premium, consistent and consumer-led execution from pinnacle experiences to fleet-wide scale.

• Coordinate retail brand programmes and contribute to effective project delivery across multiple stakeholders, priorities and timelines.

• Use campaign results, consumer feedback and marketplace learnings to identify opportunities to improve future planning and execution.

• Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team culture, bringing curiosity, creativity, accountability and a solutions-oriented mindset.

What You Will Bring

• Relevant experience in brand marketing, retail marketing or another consumer-facing marketing role.

• Experience contributing to the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, ideally within retail or an omnichannel environment.

• A strong understanding of the French consumer and retail landscape, with particular knowledge of the 15–25-year-old Young Athlete consumer.

• A deep curiosity for local communities and subcultures, and for the sporting and cultural forces that influence and shape the next generation.

• The ability to gather, analyse and consolidate consumer, cultural and marketplace insights, then translate them into clear recommendations and locally relevant marketing plans.

• An understanding of how brand stories come to life across physical and digital retail touchpoints.

• The ability to adapt EMEA or broader brand strategies to the specific needs of the French market without losing strategic consistency.

• The agility to move across different sport categories, consumer audiences and business priorities.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across territory and EMEA teams.

• Strong organisational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence and bring clarity to complex projects.

• A proactive, curious and solutions-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail and executional excellence.

• A genuine passion for sport, culture, retail and the Nike brand.

• Fluency in both French and English is required.

Please note, applications will close on the 6th November

title: Sr. Performance Marketing Mgr, Veeqo
description:
We are seeking a Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager with experience in marketing specifically for a B2B SaaS company targeting mid-market to enterprise level clients. The ideal candidate will be a data-driven and analytical marketer with a track record of driving growth through performance marketing, specifically across paid channels including search (Google, Microsoft), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), display, and programmatic. They have experience leading cross-functional paid media initiatives in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, balancing long-term channel strategy with the ability to execute tactical optimizations in a fast-growing space. 

As the Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager you will work closely with other members of the marketing team and cross-functional teams, to develop, test, and iterate on performance marketing campaigns that drive qualified leads and revenue growth. You will own, develop and scale paid media campaigns across the full funnel with the goal of driving acquisition, adoption and engagement with Veeqo. 

It is important the candidate can foster a creative team environment, inventing new approaches to ad creative and targeting, building robust A/B testing structures, diving deep into campaign performance data, and doubling down on what's performing. 

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Performance Marketing Manager you will: 

- Develop and execute comprehensive full-funnel paid media strategies across search, social, display, and programmatic channels that deliver measurable business results. 
- Manage the day-to-day operations of paid media campaigns including launching, testing, and optimizing ad creative, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing pages across the funnel. 
- Own budget allocation and pacing across paid channels, ensuring efficient spend and maximizing return on ad spend (ROAS) and cost per acquisition (CPA). 
- Lead marketing automation and audience strategy implementation to drive program efficiency and improve lead quality. 
- Establish rigorous testing frameworks (A/B, incrementality, geo-lift) and optimization processes. Develop metrics and measurement to determine campaign effectiveness and true incremental impact. 
- Lead budget planning and forecasting for paid media initiatives. You will be responsible for actively communicating the progress and financial health of the program across the organization. 
- Drive continuous innovation in measurement, attribution, and incrementality testing across paid channels. 
- Explore and scale emerging paid media opportunities including AI-powered ad formats, new platforms (e.g., Reddit), and audience expansion strategies. 
- Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Data to align on growth initiatives and ensure paid media supports broader business objectives. 
- Manage relationships with external agencies and platform partners to maximize campaign performance. 

About the team
Veeqo (veeqo.com) – a startup which was acquired by Amazon in 2021 – is Amazon's recommended shipping, inventory, and warehouse management solution for Sellers. Our vision is to become the multi-channel solution for eCommerce sellers, for both their on-Amazon and off-Amazon business. We help sellers manage fulfillment operations across all their online stores, and ship orders to customers at the lowest cost and in the fastest possible time. If you're interested in joining a rapidly growing team with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place. 

In order to accelerate the next phase of Veeqo's development, we are committed to transforming the depth, scale and ambition of our marketing capabilities. The marketing team uses data, seller insights, and automation to invent, test and scale programs that raise awareness of Veeqo and drive Sellers to signup or engage with our sales team. We're in a high-growth phase and seeking exceptional talent to drive our next stage of expansion.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
- Proven track record of scaling paid media programs that delivered significant revenue impact, including measurement, creative strategy, audience targeting, and activation across all parts of the funnel.
- Deep hands-on experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and/or Meta Ads at scale.
- Strong understanding of paid media technology, bid management, attribution models, and marketing automation platforms.
- Ability to analyze raw campaign data and develop actionable insights related to paid media performance. Understanding of basic statistics and mathematical modeling concepts such as statistical significance, standard deviations, and regression analysis.
- Experience with incrementality testing, geo-lift studies, or other advanced measurement methodologies.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with 4+ years specifically in paid media and demand generation.
- Experience managing six-figure+ paid media budgets with demonstrated ability to optimize spend efficiency while scaling volume.

- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL, Excel, and BI tools.

title: Amazon Key – B2B Growth marketer, Amazon Key
description:
Amazon Key is building an infrastructure-agnostic access layer for the housing sector that overlays intelligent keyless access onto existing electrical systems for communal entrance without replacing what is already installed. For contractors and staff who work across multiple buildings and portfolios, it replaces fragmented keys, codes and sign-in processes with a single seamless UX on their phone. For property teams, it creates a centralized process, with tamper-proof audit trails that becomes the one system of record for every non-resident entry, every day. For delivery drivers, it grants secure, time-bound access to communal entrances so parcels arrive safely inside the building instead of being left exposed or bounced back as failed deliveries; no keys, fobs or resident buzz-in required. We have a proven product and now we need an engine: a repeatable, instrumented, signal-driven machine that finds the right accounts, reaches the right decision-makers with the right message at the right moment, and hands Sales a warm, qualified, prioritized queue every single day.
We are looking for a B2B Growth marketer to design, build, and own that engine. This is a founding, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will treat go-to-market like software: define the signals that indicate a housing provider is ready to buy, build the enrichment and outbound workflows that act on those signals, wire them into the CRM, measure conversion at every stage. 
You will be the technical architect of lead generation, outbound, and signal detection for Amazon Key across the. 
This role is highly cross-functional. 

Key job responsibilities
• Design the signal layer. Define and codify the buying signals that indicate an housing provider is in-market. Build the pipelines that detect them continuously.
• Build the lead-gen engine end-to-end. Own sourcing → enrichment → scoring → routing → sequencing → attribution as a versioned, monitored system. Turn target-account lists into instrumented outbound programs.
• Automate enrichment and data quality: Build data extraction and scraping flows from scratch. Stand up custom web-scraping and data-extraction pipelines where no clean source exists, feeding them into enrichment so target lists are built, not bought.
• Generate account-specific outreach at scale. Build AI-assisted systems that produce personalized, on-message outreach for named accounts and multi-channel cadences with strong deliverability hygiene.
• Instrument and report conversion. Define the funnel metrics (reply rate, meeting rate, pilot rate, stage conversion, time-to-money) and build the dashboards that feed conversion heartbeat.
• Integrate the GTM stack.
• Run experiments like an engineer. Ship, measure, iterate, and deprecate.
• Read the commercial picture, not just the tech. You understand how a housing deal actually gets won, where demand comes from, how a prospect moves from first touch to signature, and which numbers predict revenue. That lets you decide what to build and what to drop based on impact on the funnel, so the engine is judged by deals closed, not workflows shipped.
• Run your own show end to end. Give you a problem and a goal, not a spec, and you'll scope it, build a first version, put it in front of users, and keep refining until it holds up in production. You chase down what's broken yourself, close your own knowledge gaps, and carry a problem all the way to a working result rather than handing it off half-solved.

A day in the life
The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent

- Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
- Experience in finance, business management and sales operations

title: Sr. GTM Lead, MeasurTwitch , Twitch Ads
description:
About Amazon Ads 

Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising. Amazon Ads offers unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We believe that advertising, when done well, can connect the right brands with the right consumers while delivering holistic value. 

Twitch is the world's leading live-streaming platform, home to a highly engaged, hard-to-reach audience that spends billions of minutes each month watching gaming, entertainment, sports, music and creator-led content. As Twitch continues to scale its advertising proposition across EMEA, the ability to articulate the unique value of Twitch audiences to advertisers is a critical growth lever - and a capability we are building from the ground up. 

This is an individual contributor role embedded within the Twitch Go-to-Market (GTM) team who will focus on Insights and Measurement. You will work extensively with the Twitch sales specialists, GTM leads, product and ad-tech teams to develop and deliver insights that directly fuel revenue growth. 

This is not a backend role. You will actively participate in customer meetings as the subject matter expert on Twitch audience insights & measurement, and leverage Amazon's rich array of insights and measurement solutions - combined with Twitch-native data - to deliver media strategies that position Twitch as an essential part of the advertising mix.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the Twitch insights playbook from scratch: Develop a scalable library of Twitch audience insights, competitive benchmarks and measurement case studies that the sales team can deploy across pitches, QBRs and strategic conversations. 

- Equip the sales team to sell with confidence: Translate complex Twitch audience data (viewership, engagement, demographics, content affinities) into clear, compelling narratives that articulate the unique and incremental value of Twitch to advertisers. 

- Establish and advance senior-level relationships: Build relationships with senior marketing decision makers (e.g. Senior Director, C-level) by positioning yourself as the go-to expert on Twitch audience intelligence and at least one advanced analytical area of advertising. 

- Generate data-driven insights: Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, Twitch-native signals, third-party research and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights that prove the impact of advertising on Twitch. 

- Develop Twitch measurement expertise: Develop expertise in Twitch-specific metrics and Amazon's proprietary measurement tools, working to constantly evolve how we analyse and communicate the value of Twitch audiences to advertisers. 

- Directly support revenue growth: Partner with GTM and sales leadership to identify the highest-impact insight gaps, prioritise your roadmap accordingly, and measure your work against pipeline and revenue outcomes. 

- Advocate for data-driven decision-making: Guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions, with a particular focus on demonstrating Twitch's role in full-funnel and cross-platform strategies. 

- Influence product and go-to-market strategy: Write internal documents with strategic recommendations that influence the direction of Twitch advertising products, measurement capabilities and go-to-market working mechanisms with internal stakeholders. 

- Scale your analyses: Actively scale your analyses to other categories or locales through AI-native solutions. 

A day in the life
No two days at Amazon are the same. You will have the flexibility to work with your stakeholders and define a book of business that will maximise your impact on Twitch revenue. On any given day, you might find yourself: 
- Building a bespoke audience profile to help a seller win a competitive brief in colaboration with our Audience&Insights organization
- Presenting Twitch viewership insights at a sales-led event or advertiser summit 
- Partnering with the GTM team to shape the narrative for a tentpole moment like TwitchCon 
- Running an intricate analysis to influence a key advertiser decision 
- Working with the product/engineering team to pilot a new measurement solution tailored to live-streaming environments 
- Collaborating with the A&I team to bring methodological rigour to a Twitch-specific research project 

About the team
Twitch GTM team - a small, high-impact squad responsible for equipping Twitch-dedicated sellers across EU5 with the strategies, tools and narratives they need to hit ambitious growth targets. You will also work closely with the Analytics & Insights (A&I) team within Amazon Ads, a sales enablement group responsible for developing actionable and innovative insights that prove the value of Amazon Ads to advertisers and partners. 

Your unique position bridging both teams means you will bring the rigour and methodology of A&I together with the commercial urgency and customer proximity of GTM - a combination that is essential to closing the insights gap and unlocking Twitch's revenue potential.

- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking
- Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager to join us in London and help build the future of the Tax Services document printing product, which is responsible for generating billions of business-critical documents (e.g. tax invoices, commercial and transport documents) every year. As a Sr Product Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our document printing product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

title: Talent Marketing Manager, AIM (Attraction, Influence and Marketing)
description:
We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale — come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, execution and performance behind two of the AIM organization's most critical marketing functions: activation management and integrated marketing and campaign planning across Workforce Staffing's global hiring portfolio. This role starts with the customer: understanding hiring needs, translating them into marketing goals, and owning how those goals are achieved. You define how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are strategically planned, measured and optimized, and how the team scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.

As a marketing strategist and cross-functional operator, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across priority geographies globally. You translate complex performance data into decisive activation recommendations, manage daily pacing and spend governance, and own the narrative for senior leadership. You flex between deep-focus, data-rich environments and wide-focus, relationship-heavy environments with equal confidence.

You shape organizational strategy, build trust, drive clarity, and solve problems before they escalate.

Your insights don't just inform decisions — they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps and align business managers on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. You build the trust, mechanisms, and reporting that close the existing gap. You don't wait for perfect data — you make decisions with what exists and build toward what's needed.

Key job responsibilities
Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the annual marketing strategy and plan the direction for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order trajectory across your portfolio. Lead quarterly strategy reviews, updating priorities based on performance data, market shifts, and evolving business needs. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Push back on media recommendations with data where channel performance does not support continued investment.

Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across assigned markets, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for assigned markets, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events. Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate changing labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive collaboration with Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Creative, Talent Engagement, Marketing Analytics, and Business stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams. Bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Manage a wide portfolio of countries with varying levels of data maturity, labour order certainty, and stakeholder sophistication.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Oversee daily pacing reviews, implementing ramp-down or pause decisions when application delivery targets are met. Share insights with Performance Marketing to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own escalation thresholds and spend decision governance.

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Own weekly and monthly Business Review deep dive presentations for senior leadership, translating risk sites and marketing performance into clear strategic narrative. Maintain regular alignment with Business Managers and cross-functional partners on fill rate risk and marketing actions. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. Adapt communication to audience maturity — from sophisticated data-driven forums to foundational trust-building conversations.

Application Quality & Fill Rate Improvement: Monitor performance against goals including fill rate, non-paid application share, spend per hire, and application-to-usable application ratios. Implement data-driven optimisations for underperforming sites. Identify quality gaps (geo-targeting, shift messaging, channel mix) and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Creative, and Owned Marketing teams to resolve. Own the activation logic that balances cost efficiency with fill rate delivery.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes — from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with reviewing overnight pacing data across your markets and making activation decisions for the day. You join the weekly reporting call with your stakeholders, leading the marketing view for your area with a clear recommendation for each at-risk site. Mid-morning, you're on a stakeholder call with business partners in Brazil translating application pacing risk into language they understand and building alignment on marketing levers available. After lunch, you're deep-diving a high-spend site in Germany where channel efficiency has dropped — pulling site-level data, identifying the issue, and producing an internal discussion analysis for the Paid Marketing team. In the afternoon, you're working through quarterly initiatives with other teams — defining what to learn, which markets to test in, and how results will inform next quarter's strategy. Later, you prepare the MBR narrative for senior leadership, connecting this month’s activation decisions to fill rate outcomes. You close the day connecting the dots: what patterns are emerging across your portfolio, what's working, what needs to change, and how to translate that into the quarterly strategy update you're presenting to leadership next week.

Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences — engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience in marketing or marketing research
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

title: Category Manager Power & Utilities, Global Procurement Organization (GPO)
description:
We are the Global Procurement Organization, and we're on a mission to reshape how one of the world's largest companies powers its operations with clean energy. We're looking for a Category Manager to lead and develop our on-site solar energy portfolio across Europe, the UK, and the Middle East, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver hundreds of megawatts of new capacity and tens of millions in cost savings.

You'll be building the playbook for solar procurement in some of the fastest-growing renewable energy markets on the planet:

Manage the full solar portfolio across diverse markets from Western Europe to the Arabian Peninsula, collaborating with regional stakeholders in markets where solar capacity is projected to grow 10x by 2035

Navigate complex regulatory landscapes—from EU clean energy mandates to Saudi Vision 2030 and the UAE's ambitious renewable targets

Structure creative deals, deciding when to deploy capital purchases vs. power purchase agreements vs. operating lease models across markets with very different economics

Contribute to meaningful sustainability impact—your work will directly eliminate thousands of metric tons of CO2 annually while reducing grid dependency across hundreds of logistics facilities, supporting Amazon's climate commitments

Help build a category from the ground up in emerging Middle East markets, working with local teams where solar is unlocking operations in locations where traditional grid connections aren't even possible

If you enjoy solving complex problems across cultures and borders, and want your work to have measurable environmental and financial impact, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute the long-term sourcing strategy for on-site solar across Europe, UK, and Middle East, covering rooftop, carport, and ground-mount technologies, in partnership with engineering and sustainability teams
- Lead portfolio-based tenders, bundling demand across multiple countries to maximise negotiation leverage and reduce procurement cycle times
- Build financial models—including net present value, total cost of ownership, and payback analysis—to support investment decisions and senior leadership recommendations
- Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships through quarterly business reviews, performance tracking, and capacity planning while maintaining competitive tension across the vendor base
- Identify and mitigate supply chain risks including equipment lead times, trade policy shifts, and regional market constraints
- Track energy production performance against forecasts and collaborate with technical teams to drive continuous improvement in system output and cost efficiency
- Lead category consolidation efforts, bringing fragmented solar activities under a unified procurement framework to unlock savings and standardise specifications

A day in the life
Your day starts with a portfolio review call across European markets, then shifts to negotiating contract terms with a supplier for a compliance-driven deployment. After lunch, you're deep in a financial model stress-testing deal structures for a new Middle East opportunity. By afternoon, you're syncing with engineering, legal, finance, sustainability, and construction partners to keep projects on track. The variety is constant—and no two days look the same as you move between strategy, negotiation, and execution across time zones.

About the team
You'll join the Power and Utilities team within Amazon's Global Procurement Organization. We manage the full energy lifecycle for Amazon's worldwide operations across five areas: utilities supply and audits, power infrastructure and grid services, on-site renewables and storage, EV charging infrastructure, and hydrogen mobility solutions. title: AI Design Technologist, Marketing Productivity, Amazon Ads Marketing
description:
Amazon Ads Marketing is building an AI-native team to drive the transformation of the marketing organization to integrate AI into our operating model with precision and scale. We are looking for AI Builders who are passionate about using AI-assisted development to build solutions that make marketers dramatically more productive.
As a design technologist on this team, you will operate at the intersection of AI-native development, UX design, and marketing operations. You will build prototype solutions, working agents, and production-ready tools that solve marketer pain points. Your work will directly drive the organization's productivity goals by shipping AI-relevant use cases from pilot to production.
This is a ground-floor opportunity to build a new team approaching the work through AI-native workflows. You will work closely with marketing stakeholders, UX designers, product managers, and engineering partners to identify where AI can absorb labor-heavy work, then build the solutions that make it happen. Your prototypes and reference code will set the standard for how AI transforms marketing at Amazon Ads.
You are an independent contributor. You build prototypes and working samples that creatively solve difficult business and technology constraints. Your scope is on medium-to-large projects where the product strategy is often defined, but the UX and technology approach is not. You engage proactively with stakeholders to define priority use cases, logical workflows, and tech-forward solutions.

Key job responsibilities
• Build AI-powered prototype solutions, agents, and automations that solve Ads Marketing pain points. Produce working samples, agent frameworks, and reference code demonstrating how AI-powered marketing workflows can be implemented and scaled.
• Transform defined UX and marketing workflow ideas into working code using AI-assisted development tools and technologies (Python, JavaScript, Node, AWS services, API integrations). Prototype and ship AI use cases from pilot to production, directly contributing to productivity goals.
• Work backward from marketers and collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to iterate on optimal experiences. Identify UX and workflow issues before the dev/test cycle when fixes are less costly.
• Evaluate first-party and third-party AI tools and their integration with core marketing systems, ensuring solutions account for real-world constraints. Develop reusable prototyping methods, agent frameworks, and reference architectures enabling rapid problem-solving.
• Contribute to creating and adopting prototyping tools, frameworks, and platforms for the team and broader marketing organization. Document prototypes to preserve intent and learnings for future team members.
• Participate in design reviews, present work to stakeholders, and advocate for the marketer's perspective in all AI-powered solutions.

A day in the life
This AI Builder prototypes AI-powered marketing solutions using AI-assisted development tools. They collaborate with internal stakeholders (UX designers, product managers, engineers, marketing ops) and serve marketers within Amazon Ads Marketing as primary customers.

The role solves labor-intensive workflow problems by coding prototypes in Python/JavaScript, designing AI agents, evaluating tools for marketing integration, and participating in design reviews. They move use cases from concept to production while establishing reusable frameworks that enable AI adoption across the marketing organization. 

About the team
The Ads Marketing AI Enablement is a new team within Marketing Effectiveness & Intelligence (ME&I), responsible for driving the successful transformation of the Ads Marketing org to an AI native operating model. The team's primary measure of success is value-based productivity attributed to AI transformation.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience as a front-end technologist, engineer, or UX prototyper
- Have coding samples in front end programming languages
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience developing visually polished, engaging, and highly fluid UX prototypes
- Experience collaborating with UX, Product, and technical partners

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Knowledge of databases and AWS database services: ElasticSearch, Redshift, DynamoDB
- Experience with machine learning (ML) tools and methods

title: EU Sr. Product Manager, Customer Experience Improvement
description:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is a large and global organization, obsessed with taking care of our customers and delivering reliably fast, convenient, and helpful support when they need it. Whether customers interact with our self-serve solutions or CS Associates, we work hard to make sure they have a delightful experience with us, each and every time.
We are looking for a customer-obsessed product leader to join us in the EU Customer Experience Improvement org within Customer Service. You will be a part of the EU team of program managers, product managers, business analysts, and business intelligence engineers who dig deep into customer friction, trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product and programmatic improvements to improve CX. You and your team will own the roadmap of EU strategic initiatives while also responding to emerging issues that need immediate attention.

Key job responsibilities
The role requires someone who can use significant expertise and high judgment to distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and stakeholders to set a vision and design the right long-term solutions. You will spend your time analyzing customer friction data to identify the biggest opportunities and building compelling cases for improvements. This means diving deep into significantly complex problems where defects create friction across multiple parts of the customer journey. You will work across multiple organizations and leadership to influence and achieve consensus on priorities.

You will partner on product and technology solutions within and outside the Amazon Customer Service org to drive high impact innovation and improvements that can transform the service experience we offer to our customers. 
You will create mechanisms that make defect elimination sustainable. This includes building dashboards and tools that show customer impact, designing processes that catch problems before they reach customers, and establishing metrics that keep everyone focused on goals. You will be regularly working at both tactical and strategic levels to deliver results. 

This is the right role for you if:
- You can handle significantly complex problems and efforts, with the ability to see both visible and not-yet-visible risks.
- You excel at taking complex technical problems and explaining them clearly to drive consensus among stakeholders.
- You can work strategically to determine where resources are best applied while actively working to remove bottlenecks.
- You create scalable mechanisms and best practices while effectively influencing and force multiplying across organizations.
- You have deep customer obsession and can translate that into measurable improvements in customer experience.

A day in the life
- Lead customer experience workstreams by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of friction.

- Create scalable mechanisms to work across cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
- Establish data-driven approaches to detect issues, surface customer pain points and drive upstream action across organizations.

- Understand how AI is reshaping CX product architectures, product development and customer workflows; apply AI to enable faster learning cycles, accelerate development, make better decisions and unlock new forms of innovation 

- Influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, engineering and business approach (internally and externally if applicable), vendors, partners, and organization priorities.
- Influence senior leaders to prioritize and address systemic customer experience issues through high-quality analytics and communication.
- Advocate for customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations.
- Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals.
- Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making.

- Coach and develop high-performing teams while creating leadership opportunities.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience with product cycles of 6+ months
- Experience in product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Ads Brand Safety and Suitability
description:
Amazon Ads Brand Safety & Suitability protects advertisers from exposure to unsafe, unsuitable, or policy-violating content across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio advertising inventory. Our mission is to ensure that every ad impression delivered through Amazon's demand-side platform appears adjacent to content that meets advertiser trust expectations while giving brands granular controls to define suitability on their own terms. We operate at the intersection of advertiser trust, publisher quality, and supply integrity.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager who possesses stakeholder management, program management, and well-rounded technical capabilities. You will drive the execution of complex, cross-organizational programs that protect advertiser trust at scale - including vendor integrations, enhancing capabilities across evolving supply types such as CTV, audio and gaming. You will work across multiple teams with evolving priorities, define clarity where ambiguity exists, and make trade-offs to drive program delivery. As a Sr. TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints. You will work across engineering, science, product, policy, legal, and external partners to deliver programs that directly impact advertiser confidence.

- Be grounded in a deep understanding of how customers increasingly turn to AI to solve problems, discover content, and get things done, while translating that insight into AI-driven customer experiences that feel natural, fast, and personal. 
- Work inherently cross functionally. You will work closely with engineering, design, finance, legal, business development, customer service, and executive teams to bring products to market.

title: Applied Scientist, Prime Video Commerce Insights
description:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next
generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
 
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and
movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
 
Prime Video Commerce's mission is to present the right offer to the right customer at the right time — across subscriptions, channels, and transactional video, in every market and on every device. Our science team replaces static business rules with ML-driven decisions that personalise the entire commerce journey, from discovery through checkout and beyond. We operate at scale across hundreds of millions of customers, and we are expanding into new frontiers — combining the latest advances in agentic and generative AI, behavioural simulation, and causal inference to understand the impact of our decisions before they reach customers.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Prime Video Commerce Insights team in London. You will develop and deploy customer-facing models, understand customer behaviour at scale, and explore emerging techniques that help us make better decisions faster. This is a delivery focused role within a high-visibility multidisciplinary group of engineers and scientists, focused on improving the customer experience for Prime Video.

Key job responsibilities
- Research, design, and implement machine learning approaches (e.g. reinforcement learning and recommendation systems) that personalise across different customer touch points.
- Collaborate with engineers to deploy and integrate successful experiment results into large-scale, complex Amazon production systems with low latency.
- Design and execute rigorous experiments to demonstrate the technical efficacy and business value of your methods.
- Act as a subject-matter expert and help define the science roadmap and research agenda in line with organisational priorities and production constraints.
- Provide machine learning thought leadership to technical and business leaders, thinking strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
- Work with technical product managers to work backwards from what matters to customers and deliver ML-backed solutions.
- Share results with the team and wider scientific community through documents that are both statistically rigorous and compellingly relevant.

A day in the life
You will be a research leader and innovator within the Commerce Insights organisation. You will collaborate with talented engineers and senior leaders to solve problems that are uniquely challenging at Amazon's scale: personalising commerce decisions across multiple business lines, balancing competing objectives, and positively impacting hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. The problems here are technically deep — combining large-scale ML, causal reasoning, and behavioural modelling in a domain where every decision carries real revenue and customer-experience consequences. Your research will ship to production and move metrics that matter.

About the team
You will join a team of engineers and applied scientists with a proven track record of solving highly complex, ambiguous problems — work that has produced patents and publications at top-tier conferences. The team has direct visibility to senior Prime Video leadership and collaborates broadly across Commerce, Content, and Platform teams to shape how customers discover, subscribe to, and engage with video content. This is a team that operates at the intersection of rigorous research and real-world impact, where your ideas move from whiteboard to production for hundreds of millions of customers.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Experience in building machine learning models for business application
- Professional non-internship experience in a relevant field (CS, CE, ML)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent qualification/experience

title: EMEA Head, Partnerships and Business Development, Power & Utilities, AWS Partnerships & Business Development, Power & Utilities
description:
Own the partnerships redefining how Europe's largest energy companies run on cloud and agentic AI. Structure the landmark deals, bring the full force of Amazon, and put AWS at the center of the energy transition.

Global energy demand will rise sharply over the coming decades, and the power and utilities sector is racing to modernize the grid, decarbonize, electrify transport, and meet power demand not seen in generations. AWS is investing billions in generation and delivery to power sustainable data center growth and is reinventing energy workflows with AI and the cloud. You will own the EMEA partnership portfolio end-to-end with the region's largest and most strategically significant P&U relationships carrying multi-year portfolio responsibility rather than a single account. You will drive the regional go-to-market motion, build and launch pipeline, lead strategic planning and the development of cloud and AI strategic agreements, and integrate the commercial relationships of EMEA companies that supply infrastructure inputs to Amazon into a single, 360-degree relationship while collaborating on solution development, partner engagement, and field enablement.
This is a Principal-level individual-contributor role with no direct reports working on high complexity, high ambiguity, challenges leveraging senior level relationships. You will Think Big where there is no playbook, structuring first-of-their-kind agreements and novel commercial models in markets where AWS's position is still forming and make high-judgment calls with incomplete information (Are Right, A Lot). You will Earn Trust as the advisor of choice to energy-industry CxOs, close the region's largest multi-party agreements, and act as a force multiplier who raises the bar across the BD team through mentorship, reusable playbooks, and visible thought leadership (Hire and Develop the Best, Invent and Simplify).

Key job responsibilities
•Own and execute the EMEA go-to-market partnership plan across generation, transmission, distribution, and energy trading, including solution prioritization, repeatable pipeline generation, competitive positioning, and scalable partner co-sell motions (ISVs, SIs, OEMs, utilities).
•Structure and close the region's largest strategic agreements encompassing a confluence of commitments to technology, infrastructure, and AI with major EMEA energy customers.

•Act as the managed gateway between EMEA account teams and AWS Infrastructure and power-procurement teams, coordinating and elevating commercial power discussions.
•Orchestrate a pan-Amazon network (Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Amazon Business, Sustainability) into EMEA engagements as inputs to strategic agreement value propositions.
•Partner with sales and technical teams to design, test, and scale go-to-market sales plays, proven in key accounts and then scaled across thousands through the field and partners.
•Maintain the EMEA named-account and white-space map, and hand qualified opportunities to Sales with clear business driver, stakeholders, and urgency.
•Mentor and uplevel BD peers and field teams, codifying wins into reusable playbooks (a natural fit with the Technical Field Community and the co-developed sales-play model).
Basic qualifications
•Demonstrable experience explaining the value of cloud services to power and utility customers, including differentiation from competing platforms; fluency with large-scale migrations; experience shaping AI strategy; and a track record of documenting and delivering go-forward collaboration strategies.
•Proven ability to influence without authority and to mentor or uplevel peers in a matrixed organization.
•Experience independently structuring and executing large-scale, multi-party commercial agreements ($300M+) with enterprise energy, utility, or infrastructure customers, under significant ambiguity.
•Working knowledge of cloud, AI/ML, and emerging technologies applied to energy-industry challenges, including a vision for agentic AI.
Preferred qualifications
•Deep familiarity with EMEA energy-sector dynamics — grid interconnection, long-lead-time equipment procurement, data center power siting, decarbonization, and regulatory, permitting, and supply-chain constraints.
•History of building pan-enterprise or cross-business-unit relationships in strategic customer engagements.
•Track record of thought leadership and of creating reusable mechanisms adopted by others.
•Familiarity with PPA structures and the commercial interface between hyperscaler power procurement and energy suppliers.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience across Core Cloud Technology Services, including Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and Networking, and Business Application Technologies, including EUC, Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and Communication Developer Services.
- Experience solving technology-related business challenges across Healthcare/Life Sciences, Media & Entertainment, Global Financial Services, Telecommunications, Automotive & Manufacturing, and Energy & Utilities.
- Experience in Go-To-Market (GTM), Business Development, Sales, or Consulting.
- Experience across Advanced Compute (Accelerated Compute, HPC, Visual/Spatial Compute, IoT), Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration (Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, Cloud Operations), and Data & AI technologies (AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, Storage).
- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or 16+ years of equivalent professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial leadership.
- 12+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial roles within the power and utilities or broader energy sector.

- Experience selling to Fortune 1000 or Global 2000 organizations

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon Freight EU
description:
Amazon Freight EU runs across LTL, FTL, and Intermodal ship-modes and product org in this business delivers tech roadmap that helps delivers strategy for growth, profitability and shipper experience. This role is the single threaded owner for product execution in the AF EU product org. Product managers build the roadmap and this role ensures effective delivery of that roadmap. It owns the OP1/OP2 roadmap and short-term cycle plans across dependent tech teams like ASCS Tech, MMPO, Middle Mile Research Science, Relay, Relay Yards, Sort Tech, and SWA. The work involves pulling those teams' dependencies onto one aligned plan, manage the trade-offs when their priorities and timelines collide, and drive sequencing, unblocking, and escalation week over week.

Landing AF EU priorities against those teams' own roadmaps requires someone who builds the mechanisms (planning cadences, prioritisation forums, escalation paths) and secures senior leadership sponsorship to hold commitments. This role drives profit improvements of 10s of millions of euros for the business through product launches and enhancements.

Own the AF EU product and program roadmap across LTL, FTL, and Intermodal, and turn OP1/OP2 strategy into delivered outcomes
Own the OP1/OP2 and cycle plans roadmap end to end across the seven dependent tech teams, bringing their dependencies onto a single aligned plan
Set priorities across the portfolio and resolve trade-offs when teams' priorities and timelines collide

title: Category Manager, Construction Category, Global Procurement Organization
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of Amazon's construction procurement landscape in Europe? Amazon's Global Procurement Organization (GPO) is seeking a Category Manager to lead strategic construction procurement activities across our diverse portfolio of multi-million-dollar real estate projects.

As a key member of our Construction Category Procurement Pillar, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on Amazon's growth and innovation in Europe. The ideal candidate will bring deep understanding of construction trades including civil and architectural works, interior fit-out, MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) systems, and fire protection.

We're looking for a dynamic leader who thrives in our fast-paced, results-driven environment. This role offers unique opportunities to influence major construction projects, drive sustainable procurement practices, and collaborate with world-class professionals across Europe. If you're a self-starter who excels in complex, challenging environments and has a passion for construction procurement, this role could be your next career milestone.

This role offers exceptional visibility with senior leadership and the chance to make lasting improvements to Amazon's construction procurement ecosystem. Your success will directly contribute to Amazon's ambitious growth plans, competitiveness and environmental commitments across Europe.

- Develop and execute construction category sourcing strategies across different supply chain tiers (General Contractors, Subcontractors, Suppliers, OEMs) and trades (including civil, architectural, MEP, fire protection, and fit-out) across Europe
- Take responsibility for increasing Amazon's competitiveness and maintain continuity of supply and mitigate risks across geographical and business unit boundaries, defining opportunities to suit the particular needs of Amazon business
- Focus on deep diving construction categories and regions to add value to the overall procurement process by identifying synergies, benchmarking, innovation, eliminating waste and identifying economies of scale, thus increasing our competitive advantage

- Support sustainability initiatives aligned with Amazon's Climate Pledge
