- Apply technical knowledge of construction trades to assess supplier capabilities, evaluate proposals, and drive value engineering initiatives
- Drive procurement of innovative, sustainable, and cost-effective construction services to help our Operations teams succeed and delight Amazon.com customers with speed, selection and convenience
- Collaborate with technical teams to optimize specifications across various construction disciplines
- Serve as the key interface between project delivery and any internal central core team from Design and Construction, Real Estate and Legal partners and the senior leadership of external supply chain (General Contractors, Subcontractors, Suppliers, OEMs)
- Support supplier performance management together with Design and Construction partners
- Provide insight and knowledge of the construction industry and supply chain and in turn develop procurement strategies to support/inform strategic decision making
- Prepare high quality white papers and anticipate objections to proposed procurement approach and gain buy-in from decision makers, including managing differing perspectives to a recommended position. Influence decision-making at senior leadership levels
- Adapt and sometimes take different roles from strategy development to project management to rapidly meet customer needs

You'll join a growing team where your strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and leadership skills will be paramount. Working in an environment that encourages autonomy and creative problem-solving, you'll partner closely with Design and Construction, Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams to shape and execute innovative category strategies.

description:

Customer Success
Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team's expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

Salesforce is currently seeking a Data Cloud & Marketing Cloud Technical Architect to join our Professional Services team within the Customer Success Group (CSG). This role is centered on being a "Data" subject matter expert, leading the design and implementation of enterprise-grade Data Management solutions. While Data Cloud (Data 360) expertise is a must, the ideal candidate will also possess a strong background in Salesforce Marketing Cloud to drive cross-cloud success.

The Technical Architect is responsible for architecting scalable solutions across enterprise landscapes, ensuring data is democratized and ready for enterprise AI usage. You will work closely with Project Managers and Technical Architects to ensure on-time, fully functioning integrations. The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial atmosphere, communicates tactfully with business operations, and effectively designs, tests, and deploys complex software solutions. You must be an excellent communicator who can tailor delivery to a variety of audiences and communicate both in English and Italian fluently.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

• Become a Trusted SME: Act as the primary authority for Data Cloud to support project delivery, including how data architecture relates to the success of Agentforce and AI.

• Strategic Design: Drive the creation of application and technical design documents (Blueprints/FSD) which leverage Salesforce best practices and effectively integrate Salesforce into the customer's infrastructure.

• Data Democratization: Design and guide customer's enterprise data architecture, highlighting the importance of Data Governance and ensuring solutions adhere to security and privacy regulations.

• Technical Excellence: Provide guidance on integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, and environment management. Lead code reviews and define coding standards (SQL, SSJS, AMPScript).

• Stakeholder Management: Facilitate and influence Executive Customer stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI.

• Risk Mitigation: Troubleshoot key customer implementation issues and demonstrate the ability to drive to a successful resolution through proactive risk management.

You're Our Person If...

• Data Cloud Expertise: Direct experience designing and configuring the Data Cloud (Data 360) platform to enable enterprise use cases (Ingestion, Unified Profile, Insights, and Activation) or Marketing Cloud Mastery: 2+ years of direct experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio). Knowledge of AMPScript and SSJS is a strong plus.

• Minimum of 10 years' experience in professional services

• Architectural Proficiency: Deep knowledge in MDM, Data Distribution, and Data Modeling concepts, with a strong understanding of metadata and lineage.

• Solution Documentation: Ability to clearly and articulately document solutions, including data flows, engineering flowcharts, and technical artifacts.

• Requirement Translation: Ability to create a solution based on client requirements and map Business Processes into our technical product suite (e.g., mapping Data Cloud DMOs to Marketing Cloud Data Extensions).

• Cross-Cloud Integration: Knowledge of API patterns (REST/SOAP) and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CRM, Data Lakes).

• Technical Leadership: Lead inter-team meetings on technical and business challenges; conduct solutions testing and validation.

• Language Skills: Proficiency in English AND Italian languages is mandatory.

• Mobility: Travel to client sites for onsite discovery and solutions presentations (estimated 25% - 50%).

• Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

Even Better If...

• AI & Personalization: Familiarity with Agentforce Marketing and Marketing Cloud Personalization (formerly Interaction Studio).

• Strategic Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, able to present complex concepts at both tactical and executive levels.

This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

Adyen is a full-stack payment processor and licensed global bank, serving millions of businesses and billions of shoppers. As we grow into banking, card issuing, and embedded finance, the stakes of who we let into our platform, and what they do once they’re here, keep rising.

Fraud Intelligence protects Adyen from two kinds of bad actors: those who disguise who they are to gain access to the financial system, and those who set out to cause financial loss for Adyen or our customers.

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead a senior team of product managers across Identity Fraud & KYC, Commercial Risk, and Platform Fraud. You’ll work hand in hand with our global Compliance and Operations teams to build a data-driven defense, from onboarding through every transaction. This is not a standard product role. We need a biztech leader with strong technical instincts who runs the domain like a high-growth business.

What You’ll Do

• Set the Vision: Own the strategy for how Adyen detects and stops identity fraud and platform fraud. Treat these capabilities like your own business, balancing customer value, revenue, and cost.

• Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Coach and grow a team of senior product managers who own their domains end to end.

• Partner Globally: Work closely with global Compliance and Operations teams to turn regulatory obligations into automated, auditable products. Bring a pragmatic commercial lens to how those obligations are met.

• Make the Hard Calls: Decide where ML and automation beat manual review, and drive alignment across Engineering, Commercial, Risk, and Operations without direct authority, even when that means saying “no”.

Who You Are

• Product Leader: 8+ years in product management, including hands-on experience hiring and developing product managers.

• Commercially Minded: Analytical and metrics-driven, with the accountability of a P&L owner.

• Technically Fluent: A solid grasp of ML and data-driven products, and the confidence to work with engineers on petabyte-scale systems.

• Grounded in the Space: A working knowledge of fraud, KYC/KYB, or financial crime. Experience in fintech, payments, or regulated industries is a strong plus.

• Influential Communicator: Clear and confident with technical, commercial, and executive audiences worldwide.

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. title: Senior Forward Deployed Product Manager (Dublin)
description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

In AI, proximity to customer reality is the moat. Even the best model doesn't run itself: it takes someone who gets close enough to a customer's business to make it work, and that closeness doesn't happen on its own.

That's where the Forward Deployed Product Manager comes in. You'll work directly with our biggest customers at the moments that matter most in their journey with Fin, whether that's proving out value in an evaluation, getting a deployment live, or expanding what's possible once it's working, and get them to real, measurable success with Fin faster than they'd get there on their own. What you learn with them feeds back into the product, so every customer after them gets there faster and better too.

This is a very novel role in the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what great looks like at Fin: evolving the playbooks, and shaping how we win and deliver on our biggest, highest-stakes deals.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for a PM who wants real time with customers and hands-on time with the product, and who's comfortable making progress before every answer is known.

What will I be doing? 

• Own outcomes for a portfolio of strategic customers deploying Fin. Understand their business, their support operation, and their technical environment well enough that the deployment plan you propose earns trust immediately.

• Run the full arc yourself. Pitch and demo Fin, scope the solution, hands-on configure it (including custom development if required), and unblock whatever gets in the way, whether that's a product gap, a technical integration, or a cross-functional snag.

• Be the AI expert in the room. Customers should leave every conversation with you knowing more about how to get outstanding results from Fin.

• Partner tightly with Sales, Success, and R&D so each deployment feels like one team to the customer, not a relay race.

• Turn what you learn in the field into product. Bring specific, evidence-backed input, not just feature requests, to shape the roadmap.

• Build the playbook as you go: the deployment patterns, templates, and best practices that make the next ten deployments faster than the first.

• Help define what Forward Deployed PM means at Fin. It's a very novel role across the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what it looks like here.

Success in this role looks like your customers thriving with Fin, and the product getting sharper because of what you learned from them. It's product management at its core, not solutions engineering, customer success, or professional services.

What skills do I need? 

• Experience: No minimum years required. We care about impact, drive, and potential, evidenced through the skills below, not tenure.

• Customer obsession: Deep empathy paired with a bias for action. You're motivated by solving the real problem and delivering measurable results.

• Communication & storytelling: You can pitch Fin to a room of executives, then get into the technical weeds with their engineers, adjusting depth and tone without losing either audience.

• Technical fluency: You're able to talk to engineers and customers about modern tech stack, from APIs and SaaS infrastructure to LLMs and low-code tooling. You're comfortable onboarding a customer into more technical product setups.

• Evidence-based thinking: You use data, not anecdotes, to make the case for a deployment plan or a roadmap bet, and you're comfortable pulling and interpreting data (conversation logs, usage, CX metrics) to find the story.

• Cross-functional influence: You navigate organizational boundaries easily, and bring people together to get the best outcome for customers and Fin.

• Comfort with ambiguity: You thrive in fast-changing, undefined environments, switching fluidly between big-picture strategy and in-the-weeds execution.

• Operational rigor: Operational rigor: You're highly organized and structured, managing multiple deployments and priorities without becoming reactive, and you know when a moment calls for speed versus polish.

Even better if you have:

• Experience building product for enterprise customers

• Startup or B2B SaaS experience

• Background in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success

Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and roadmap for Elastic's embedding/reranking and vector database and related capabilities. In this senior role, you'll be the go-to expert on search/vector search, guiding the direction for technologies like vector indexing and hybrid retrieval. This position offers the chance to shape a vital part of our product, working closely with engineering and research teams to ensure that our offerings meet the needs of numerous organizations while keeping pace with the evolving landscape of AI.

What You Will Be Doing

• 
Conduct market research to uncover emerging trends in search/vector databases as well as SOTA model research in emerging areas to manage unstructured data, working alongside our model team. 

• 
Evaluate the competitive landscape to enhance product positioning and develop user personas that guide feature decisions. 

• 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align the product strategy with business goals while prioritizing features based on customer feedback and market demands.

• 
Establish long-term product goals and milestones for the vector use cases, document AI and unstructured data management to drive its development. Prioritize features and enhancements based on user feedback and technical feasibility. Allocate resources skillfully to ensure timely updates, while coordinating with engineering teams to validate roadmap assumptions. Communicate updates and expectations clearly to stakeholders and executives.

• 
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Elastic's vector database as well as core search use cases, from low-level indexing internals to the developer-facing APIs and SDKs. 

• 
Partner deeply with engineering and applied research on trade-offs, be a credible technical peer in those conversations. Define and defend the metrics that matter: recall, latency, index size, ingestion throughput, and total cost of ownership. Advance the competitiveness of Elastic AI and Vector products across all deployments - Serverless and Self-managed.

• 
Define a unified strategy and roadmap across embedding/reranking models and vector indexing/ semantic ingestion, model lifecycle, and end-to-end retrieval quality. 

• 
Manage the operating cadence. Make sure shared metrics and priorities align the research, cloud, and engineering teams. Address trade-offs where model and index decisions intersect. 

What You Bring 

• 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

• 
Master's degree in a relevant discipline preferred

• 
8+ years in product management, with significant time on technical infrastructure, databases, search, or ML/AI platforms. 

• 
You should have good working knowledge of vector search fundamentals. This includes embeddings, ANN indexing, similarity metrics, and trade-offs between recall and latency. Additionally, you need to know about hybrid retrieval. 

• 
You should have a working knowledge of generative models, model fine tuning, model capabilities and document processing for large corpus 

• 
You don't need to be a researcher, but you should hold your own with engineers on these topics. A track record of shipping developer- or infrastructure-facing products that were adopted at scale. 

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. 

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

title: AI Product Manager (Demo)
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

Celonis Demo Engineering is the creative and technical engine of our Go-To-Market strategy. We are embarking on a high-stakes mission to build the Next-Gen Demo Factory - a world where AI agents and LLMs handle the heavy lifting of demo creation.

This transformation is critical not only to maintain our lead in Process Intelligence but to ensure Celonis wins the Enterprise AI market. By feeding operational business context to AI, we enable the world’s largest companies to industrialize AI and unlock real ROI. You will co-lead this transformation within the team, architecting agentic systems and building tools that turn customer business problems into compelling demos for 1,000+ GTM colleagues inside and outside Celonis.

The work you’ll do:

• Architect Agentic Demo Builds: Lead the shift toward "Prompt-to-Demo" workflows, from Atlas mockups to in-product demos with Apollo. You will build and continuously improve AI agents to automate the generation of data stories, UI screens, and configurations from simple business requirements.

• Elevate Field Delivery & Enablement: Create "Self-Service" agentic tools that allow Sales Reps and Solution Engineers to "chat" with a demo environment. These agents will generate custom talk-tracks, executive summaries, and personalized pitch decks on demand, ensuring every pitch is "Gold Standard.". Drive adoption through enablement and iterate based on user feedback.

• Master the AI Demo Lifecycle: Own the end-to-end development**, release, and ongoing improvement** of our most strategic AI demo tools and assets. This includes identifying the highest-impact demo opportunities across pre-sales, prioritizing features, building solutions, and leading technical configuration and QA. Work with Product and engineering partners to evolve these tools alongside the Celonis platform.

• Scale Through Automation: Identify repetitive manual tasks in the demo lifecycle—from data cleaning to screen setup—and build AI-driven tools/orchestrations to reduce manual effort and demo creation time.

• Creative AI Storytelling: Use generative tools to translate complex data into visionary C-level narratives, ensuring our automated assets maintain a human-centric, high-impact quality.

The qualifications you need:

• The Builder DNA: You are a natural "problem solver through automation." You have hands-on experience building tools that help others succeed and a preference for building a scalable "generator" over manually fixing a single screen.

• 1.5+ Years of Experience: Professional experience in Value Engineering, Applied AI, Solution Engineering, Demo Engineering, Technical Consulting, or a similar "Product-adjacent" role.

• Technical Baseline: A hunger to learn new technologies and hands-on proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable programming language. You should be comfortable working with data, integrating AI models and APIs, and debugging the tools you build.

• Strategic Storyteller: The ability to identify high-impact use cases and take complex technical capabilities and turn them into a simple, value-driven business story for an executive audience.

• High Learning Velocity: The AI landscape moves fast; you must be excited to constantly experiment with new models, frameworks, and prompting techniques.

Nice to Have (Big Plus):

• Cloud Platforms & Workflows: Experience building cloud-based workflows or applications using services such as Microsoft Azure and Azure Blob Storage.

• Software Development & Delivery: Experience with GitHub, version control, deployment workflows, and maintaining web applications used by others.

• Web Applications & UI/UX: Experience with frontend development and UI/UX design, turning complex AI capabilities into intuitive web applications.

• Celonis & Process Expertise: Experience with the Celonis platform, in-product applications

What Celonis can offer you:

• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

• Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

• Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

• Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

• Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

• Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

• Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

• Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

• Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

The Global Lead, GTM Strategy and Planning will work as part of the Revenue Operations leadership team, reporting to the SVP Revenue Operations. This role is the strategic architect of Celonis' annual and multi-year GTM planning processes, coordinating across Sales, Marketing, Value Engineering, Services, Finance, and the broader business to ensure aligned, balanced, and executable go-to-market strategy. This person is responsible for ensuring our GTM investments, resource allocation, and organizational structure are optimized to drive sustainable growth and performance.

The Role:

This role owns the design and execution of our integrated GTM planning processes. You will lead comprehensive territory planning, segmentation strategy, role definition, and resource allocation exercises that balance growth objectives with sustainable unit economics. You will be the custodian of our GTM ratios and thought leader on how we structure our go-to-market. You will design and maintain the planning systems and frameworks we use to make decisions, while also being comfortable working offline and with custom modeling to stress-test plans and guide strategic decisions. You will coordinate senior stakeholders across the business to build consensus around the plan and drive alignment on priorities, resource allocation, and GTM strategy. Beyond planning, you will run critical programs and projects throughout the year that ladder up to the plan—such as Global Accounts management, New Logo strategy, and organizational design initiatives.

• Conduct periodic reviews of plan performance; identify what's working, what isn't, and inform next iteration of planning

• Serve as a strategic advisor to Revenue Operations and business leadership on GTM strategy, resource allocation, and organizational design decisions

• Drive process improvements and modernization in how we approach planning, using data, technology, and best practices to increase effectiveness

• Significant experience in SaaS and/or AI-oriented tech companies, in roles focused on GTM strategy, sales planning, revenue operations, or sales strategy

• Deep expertise in territory planning, segmentation strategy, and account assignment; demonstrated success designing and implementing planning processes

• Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS go-to-market models, sales structures, and the factors that drive ACV, ARR, win rates, and team productivity

• Hands-on experience defining and optimizing GTM ratios (AE to SDR, territories to manager, etc.); ability to articulate why ratios matter and how they impact performance

• Demonstrated ability to think through organizational design; experience designing roles, coverage models, and team structures that drive results

• Comfort with planning and modeling tools (Excel, Tableau, Looker, etc.); ability to build custom models, run scenarios, and communicate findings to leadership

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work with complex data, identify patterns, and translate insights into actionable recommendations

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; proven ability to coordinate across senior leaders, build consensus, and drive alignment

title: Senior Application Product Manager - Supply Chain - Procurement
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Celonis Business Apps Supply Chain team is an innovative group of product and technology enthusiasts focused on creating and deploying next-generation solutions in the Supply Chain domain. We are transforming how enterprise solutions are built driven by our customers' business critical problems. Our team strikes an ideal balance between deep technical execution (including advanced data engineering and AI tooling) and a sharp customer focus to create highly impactful products that accelerate value realization across our customer base.

The Role:

You will gain experience in the Supply Chain and related processes and act as the interface between customers, our Go-To-Market and our Product & Engineering teams, shaping the future of Celonis’ product offering in this domain. Take this chance to rethink the way companies run their Supply Chain processes, with a specific focus on Procurement and help our customers to accelerate their value realization with Celonis.

As an Application Product Manager for Procurement, you will operate at the intersection of customer-facing solution engineering and core product innovation to architect and deploy cutting-edge enterprise AI solutions. In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

The work you’ll do:

Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes.

• Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints.

• Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform.

• Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams.

• Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models.

• Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries.

If you are passionate about Procurement, Supply Chain, the Celonis technology, and what it can do for our customers, here's your chance to directly contribute to taking our Celonis Platform and Context Model to the next level.

The qualifications you need:

• 4+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Product Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Founding/Forward-Deployed Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a comparable technical, customer-facing role hybrid role.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Business Banking
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£80,000 - £105,000 + Benefits |

About Business Banking at Monzo

Since its launch five years ago, Monzo Business Banking has been dedicated to delivering the very best of Monzo to small businesses. Today, it's an award-winning service, empowering over 1 million businesses across the UK. 

As Monzo expands across Europe, Business Banking is entering its next phase: adapting our products and proposition for small businesses in new markets, while continuing our mission to make money work for businesses.

The Role

We’re looking for several Senior PMMs to own Product Marketing for entire products and experiences. 

A useful distinction - at Monzo, Product Marketing starts upstream in product-market fit. We're embedded in squads with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Designers, User Researchers, and Sales, bringing the voice of the customer and market into what we build, how we position it, and how we take it to market. We own customer and market understanding, positioning, proposition, launch strategy, and sales enablement. We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign strategy, creative direction, channel execution, and growth. Together, we build the right products and help them succeed in market.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market.

Where you could join

• Business Banking EU. Business Banking is entering its next phase of growth as we expand beyond the UK. In this role, you'll define how Monzo Business Banking succeeds in new European markets - understanding local customer needs, building the proposition that translates our core product into local relevance, and working across Product, Growth, Marketing, and local teams to bring those products to market. This is a senior role for someone with high autonomy who loves turning dense customer and market insight into practical decisions about what should launch.

• Business Banking. Business Banking is growing quickly, serving more than one million businesses across the UK while expanding into increasingly sophisticated customer needs. In this role, you'll shape how our products are positioned, sold, and adopted—from defining compelling product narratives to enabling Sales and partnering with Growth and Marketing on launches. This is a role for someone who enjoys sitting at the intersection of Product and commercial teams, translating customer insight into positioning, propositions, and go-to-market strategies that help more businesses choose Monzo.

Key Responsibilities

• Set Product Marketing Strategy for a set of products. You'll define a one-year Product Marketing strategy for a major area of Business Banking, connecting customer insight, market opportunity, and commercial priorities into a clear direction for the product area, rather than one individual product, with measurable business outcomes.

• Develop differentiated positioning & messaging: You'll create compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions that differentiate Monzo in the market and resonate with different customer segments. You'll build messaging frameworks that Product, Sales, Integrated Marketing, and broader marketing teams use consistently across launches and customer journeys.

• Drive competitive intelligence and market insights: You’ll build and maintain the market view for your product area. You'll become the recognised authority on your customer segment and competitive landscape, building a coherent view of the market from customer research, commercial data, competitor intelligence, and Sales insight. Your recommendations will shape product strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and commercial priorities across the Business Banking collective.

• Shape product strategy across markets. You'll partner closely with Product, Research, Design, and Data to identify customer problems, market opportunities, and competitive gaps that influence roadmap priorities. Your customer and market insight will shape what we build, not just how we bring it to market.

• Set the go-to-market strategy for priority products and markets. You'll define what audiences we prioritise, why they would choose Monzo, what needs to be true for them to switch and stay, and what success looks like - giving Product, Sales, Marketing, and local market teams a shared strategic direction for how the product enters or scales in market.

• Own product representation across the customer journey. You'll define the core proposition and value messages that should carry through key customer and sales touchpoints, so customers consistently understand why the product matters. You'll partner with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and local markets to make sure the customer experience reflects the agreed positioning.

• Enable localisation: You'll work with local market teams to determine what should remain globally consistent and what should adapt locally, ensuring positioning, customer journeys, and launches resonate in each market while strengthening the overall Monzo Business Banking proposition.

This is for you if: 

• You're recognised for your Product Marketing expertise. You're comfortable owning Product Marketing across a product area or market, and people seek your perspective on customers, competitors, positioning, and product strategy.

The Mission
Are you ready to join an ambitious and rapidly growing company that is changing the retail industry? At Glovo, our vision is to give everyone easy access to anything in the city. As a Project Manager in the Global Retail Partnerships team, you will help make this vision a reality. You will build the performance tools, insights and project structure that our global and local teams rely on to grow our most strategic retail partnerships across multiple countries.
At Glovo, Retail is one of our fastest-growing business units. • Be the analytical engine behind our most strategic global partnership projects, including the Masterplan, Business Plan and Target Setting.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Job Ref ID: JR0087979
YOUR MISSION
At Glovo, we are witnessing extraordinary growth in our Quick-commerce business, and we’re just getting started. As leaders in this space, we have a unique opportunity to increase online grocery penetration from 2-3% to over 10% in our markets.
As a Product Manager in our Quick-commerce team, you’ll play a crucial part in enhancing our core value propositions of affordability and assortment, while building customer trust through outstanding pre- and post-purchase experiences. Your challenge will be to develop innovative product features that address these opportunities and drive our growth forward.
THE JOURNEY

• Problem Solving: Utilize strong problem-solving skills to navigate challenges and devise effective solutions that drive product success.

• Critical Thinking: Apply critical thinking to assess complex situations, make informed decisions, and prioritize initiatives that maximize impact.

• Product Strategy: Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for our Quick-commerce offerings, aligning with overall business goals.

• Customer Insights: Conduct market research and gather customer feedback to identify pain points and opportunities for improvement.

• Feature Development: Lead the development of new product features, ensuring they enhance our core value propositions. Champion exceptional user experiences throughout the pre- and post-purchase journey, building customer trust and loyalty.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders to align on priorities, gather insights, and ensure successful product delivery.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, design, and data teams to deliver high-quality products on time.

• Performance Metrics: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and iterate based on data-driven insights.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

• Proven experience in product management, preferably in consumer facing products.

• Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment without excessive structure

• A strong business-driven mindset and product sense.

• Solid experience collaborating with technical stakeholders (Data, Engineering & Design).

• Strong analytical skills and experience with data-driven decision-making.

• Excellent communication skills to align a diverse set of stakeholders (both technical and non-technical), drive vision, and clearly explain user value and business impact.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

description:

As a Global Director of B2B Marketing, you'll turn Delivery Hero's first-party data into the story that brings CPG brands, media agencies and local merchants to our retail media network. title: Senior Brand Media Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and strategic Senior Brand Media Manager to join our Marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving brand awareness and growth through an efficient, effective, and insight-led media strategy across 5 foodora markets (Austria, Czechia, Hungary, Norway, Sweden).
The successful candidate will lead and support the planning, buying, execution, and optimization of large-scale brand-building campaigns across traditional and digital media channels. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, including defining media and communication strategies, driving best practices across markets, and leveraging data and insights to continuously improve campaign performance and effectiveness.
You will work closely with local and central teams, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure strong media planning and execution, while fostering consistency, innovation, and best practice across markets.
Your mission:

• Lead the global media planning and buying for foodora across all media channels (ATL, Online Branding, Influencers)

• Analyze performance, consolidate learnings and present results to key decision makers to help shape media strategy 

• Engage with local and regional Marketing teams to conduct deep dives & translate results into actionable recommendations

• Work closely with other internal departments and drive marketing strategy for our brands. This includes cross-functional projects on topics like creative & content strategy, campaigns, pricing, subscription models or cross-channel measurement

• You ideally have 6+ relevant experience in Marketing and/or Media Buying & Planning 

• Experience in FMCG, Tech and/or media agency is a big plus 

• You are analytical, logical thinking and have advanced knowledge ROI measurement 

• You are a strategic problem solver who can define and assess challenges, and communicate back to stakeholder in a clear and concise way

• You have high interest and experience in leading cross-functional projects

• Your self-organization keep you always on top of your tasks 

• You are a hands-on team player with good relationship building skills

• Excited to learn and try out new things

• Fluent in English, any other language is a plus

• Flexible working hours

• Home Office 2 x a week

• Competitive salary: your total compensation may include other benefits described above and equity and/or variable bonuses for pre-defined roles. 

• 5 weeks of vacation

• Flexible benefits which you can use for things like a MultiSport card, a cafeteria/benefits package, orders from Foodora, or for investments

• A wide range of inclusive and flexible benefits including paid leave for your child’s first day of kindergarten or school, birthday day, wedding, funeral, IVF treatment, and gender affirmation, as well as the option of full home office upon return from parental leave or before birth for partners of future mothers or adoptive parents (beyond statutory requirements)

• On-site massages and circuit training

• Free ice cream, unlimited fruit, and coffee

• Employee discounts on Alza, Smarty, O2 and others

• Advanto – the option to withdraw earned wages anytime during the month

• A unique opportunity to implement ideas that change the way of eating and shopping

• Modern, pleasant, and dog & children friendly office in DOCK IN, Prague 8

We are looking for someone to join our Customer CRM Lifecycle team within the Growth organization. We are a team dedicated to crafting and implementing long-term automated lifecycle strategies designed to engage users with our app and drive incremental business results. As a CRM Lifecycle Lead, you will be an integral part of a team that thinks big, continuously pushing the boundaries to deliver & improve impactful communication strategies that align with our company’s vision and objectives.
 
THE JOURNEY 

• Craft and optimize communications strategy: Lead the development and execution of the communications lifecycle strategy aimed at enhancing customer activation, retention and reactivation by driving user engagement. Do so, by working on optimizing and personalizing communication based on insights driven through data analysis. This includes continuously exploring new opportunities to enhance customer interactions.

• Manage complex projects: Take ownership of communication projects from inception to execution. Ensuring deadlines are met and execution set-ups are measurable to gather new insights. You will coordinate with cross-functional teams, manage timelines, and oversee project deliverables.

• Make decisions based on Data Analysis and Reporting: While not serving as the team's data analyst, you will have to take ownership of the testing framework for new tests, interpret customer data, and generate insights that inform and optimize communication strategies. 

• Excel at Stakeholder Management: Engage and collaborate with various stakeholders across the organization. Navigate conflicts effectively, ensuring that roadmaps are aligned and executed seamlessly across different teams.

• Prioritize and align strategies to OKRs: Ensure that all communication strategies and tasks for the team are prioritized and aligned with the company’s and team’s OKRs (Objectives and Key Results). Your ability to link day-to-day activities with overarching business goals will be crucial.

• Adapt and Innovate: Thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment by balancing meticulous attention to detail with the ability to deliver results swiftly. You will be expected to adapt to new challenges and contribute positively to the team dynamic.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

• 5+ years of proven experience in CRM lifecycle marketing where you acquired a strong understanding of segmentation, user journeys, and personalized automated communication, beyond adhoc sendings.

• Proven ability to project manage end-to-end CRM initiatives, from ideation to final execution.

• Hands-on experience using marketing automation tools such as Braze (preferable), HubSpot, Salesforce, etc. Not on an agency basis. 

• Analytical mindset: You are comfortable working with datasets and A/B testing frameworks to derive actionable insights and conclusions.

• Proven experience working closely with analysts and data teams. You know how to turn user data into actionable insights and have a passion for testing, learning, and iterating.

• Knowledge of HTML and/or liquid coding

• Experience in a B2C relevant industry, compared to Glovo. i.e. marketplaces / Tech or consumer apps / subscription model / ride-hailing.

• A strategic mindset. You can see the big picture, but also loves diving into the details.

• A problem solving and results-driven, can-do attitude.

• A collaborative spirit. You love working with other teams to bring ideas to life, this is powered by your outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.

• The ability to learn fast and adapt yourself to different business situations

• Hands-on attitude. You’ll have to roll up your sleeves!

• Preferably a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing or equivalent 

Nice-to-haves:

• Demonstrated ability to coach, guide, and elevate the performance of cross-functional team members.

• Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools to optimize campaign execution, automate workflows, and deliver hyper-personalized content at scale.

• Knowledge of SQL.

• Experience with Braze

• Food delivery company experience in a growth department

• Experience in international environments

description:

Job Description
Au sein de l’équipe marketing opérationnelle instore de P&G France, tu seras le responsable marketing opérationnel pour tes marques. L’objectif derrière est de convaincre nos consommateurs en magasin et d’augmenter nos ventes.
Pour cela, tu travailleras avec nos agences de créa pour la partie visuel/communication, nos agences de production pour le design et la production du matériel nécessaire ainsi que notre partenaire logistique pour la réception et l’envoi des PLV vers nos forces de vente.

Estamos buscando a nuestro próximo Senior Purchasing Manager- Social & Influencer Partnerships para unirse al equipo de Brand Building Purchases de P&G.
Tu misión será liderar la estrategia de compras y la gestión de partners —influencers, agencias, representantes y otros— en distintas categorías y mercados. Contarás con autonomía para liderar grandes proyectos, colaborar con equipos multi funcionales y desarrollarte como profesional en el área de Compras con un enfoque estratégico y de continuo contacto con otras funciones como Brand, Finanzas y Legal. También gestionarás y acompañarás a los miembros de tu propio equipo.
🎯 ¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
🤝 Sourcing Strategy Design & Implementation
Liderar para todas las categorías de P&G el diseño de las estrategias de compras y gestión comercial de partners conectándolas con las prioridades del negocio para proyectos de Social & Brand Building.
Liderar y gestionar junto con tu equipo proyectos de principio a fin: identificar, seleccionar y cualificar a los mejores partners, negociar y gestionar contratos y decisiones de selección de partners.

Colaborar mano a mano con los responsables de los equipos de Brand, Finanzas, Legal y otros departamentos de cara a alinear con ellos los retos principales del negocio y trabajar en darles una respuesta óptima que apoye las estrategias de crecimiento de la compañía.
Contribuir a la toma de decisiones de negocio aportando desde el liderazgo inteligencia de mercado, tendencias e información externa sobre partners y soluciones de mercado.

Liderar la estrategia de relaciones con nuestros partners (influencers, creadores de contenido, agencias de representación, etc) y asegurar una forma de trabajo clara y eficaz.
Liderar la estrategia de negociación y contratación de los partners, ser el punto de contacto clave entre los partners y el negocio, coordinar el seguimiento de los resultados, diseñar mejoras de forma continuada y asegurar su implementación.
Traer perspectiva externa a los equipos de P&G para impulsar innovación y nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.

Liderar la gestión de contratos y acuerdos comerciales asegurando su cumplimiento.

title: Influencer and Community Brand Manager
description:
Job Location
LISBON GENERAL OFFICE
Job Description
Passionate about growing brands through creators, culture, and conversation? Join us as we take this capability to the next level at P&G. 
 
We’re building a new Influencer & Community team within our Brand organisation — and you’ll be at the heart of it, playing a central role in how our brands come to life through creator partnerships, relevant content and real consumer conversations across Portugal. 
 
Overview of the role: 
 
As Influencer & Community Manager you’ll own end-to-end influencer partnerships, strategy and execution — from insight generation and talent selection to content delivery and performance optimisation — driving brand relevance, trust, and measurable impact across P&G’s portfolio. 
 
Alongside this, you will also ensure these creator-led moments continue to live beyond campaigns, contributing to ongoing conversation, advocacy, and community engagement across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit. 
 
Working closely with Brand, Media, and PR teams, you’ll bring global strategies to life in a way that is locally relevant, culturally sharp, and built to perform. You’ll also help shape how we use cutting-edge tools and AI to unlock the next generation of brand building. 
 
This is a hands-on role for someone who understands creator culture, platform dynamics and how to turn content and conversation into growth. 
 
What You’ll Do 
 
Influencer & Creator Strategy & Execution 

• Lead locally relevant execution of influencer, KOL, and expert strategies, in line with regional guidance 

• Identify, vet and onboard creators across tiers (micro, macro, celebrity, experts) 

• Build and manage relationships with creators, agents, and talent partners

title: Sr Marketing Director, DACH
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a commercially minded marketing leader to serve as Sr Director, Marketing for the DACH region. This role will lead the Germany, Austria, and Switzerland marketing agenda, owning end-to-end market planning, budget allocation, campaign strategy, partner marketing, and execution across a highly matrixed, two-sided network. 

The role will translate global strategies into locally relevant market plans while ensuring DACH insights inform global priorities. The successful candidate will work closely with corporate, global, and North America leadership, as well as regional Sales, Product, Finance, Analytics, Partnerships, and Marketing teams. 

This is not a traditional brand marketing role. It is a commercially focused leadership position accountable for driving measurable business growth, optimizing marketing investment, and strengthening the consumer and merchant flywheel across the PayPal ecosystem.

Essential Responsibilities: 

• Develop and articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy for the marketing function

• Provide key inputs as an industry leader and expert in marketing

• Inspire and lead the marketing team to achieve long-term success

• Align marketing strategies with PayPal-wide strategy and operations

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in marketing practices

• Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure the marketing function supports overall business goals

Minimum Qualifications:

• 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Essential Responsibilities: 

• Establish and execute the overall marketing strategy for the organization

• Influence executive-level decision-making on marketing initiatives

• Collaborate with executive leadership to align marketing strategies with business objectives

• Lead large-scale marketing projects and programs with significant impact

• Analyze market trends and competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions

• Provide strategic guidance and mentorship to marketing team leaders

As Sr Director, Integrated Marketing, you will be accountable for connecting marketing strategy and execution to commercial outcomes. You will: 

• 
• Lead the strategic development and execution of the DACH market plan. 

• Own end-to-end planning across priorities, investments, campaigns, partners, and performance. 

• Drive market share growth, customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and conversion. 

• Apply a deep understanding of two-sided network businesses and consumer fintech to identify growth opportunities across consumers, merchants, partners, and platforms. 

• Use flywheel economics to evaluate how marketing investments can create value across both sides of the network. 

• Manage the DACH marketing portfolio, prioritizing initiatives and allocating resources toward the highest-value opportunities. 

• Establish clear measurement frameworks and optimize marketing return on investment. 

• Serve as a senior member of the German country leadership team. 

• Build alignment across corporate, global, North America, and DACH stakeholders. 

• Lead and develop the DACH Consumer Marketing team. 

Your Day-to-Day 

• 
• 
• Develop annual and quarterly integrated market plans aligned to business priorities and global strategy. 

• Translate global strategies into relevant local execution, balancing enterprise consistency with DACH market needs. 

• Manage budget allocation, forecasting, investment prioritization, and performance reviews. 

• Lead integrated campaigns across the full customer funnel, from demand creation through acquisition, engagement, and conversion. 

• Develop customer and partner marketing strategies that drive measurable commercial growth. 

• Partner closely with Sales to develop co-marketing initiatives, support priority opportunities, and strengthen partner value propositions. 

• Work with growth marketing teams to capture demand, improve conversion, and accelerate performance. 

• Collaborate with Product, Finance, Analytics, Partnerships, Operations, Brand, and regional teams to deliver integrated execution. 

• Navigate complex and ambiguous business issues, manage trade-offs, and drive clear decisions and action. 

• Identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of marketing investment. 

• Share DACH insights and best practices with global teams while applying relevant global learnings locally. 

• Mentor, inspire, and develop the DACH Marketing team. 

What You Need to Succeed 

• 
• 
• Significant leadership experience in integrated, commercial, growth, consumer, fintech, payments, platform, marketplace, or similarly complex marketing environments. 

• Deep understanding of two-sided network businesses and the consumer fintech landscape. 

• Strong understanding of flywheel economics and the ability to apply it to marketing and business decisions. 

• Highly analytical, with significant experience in MROI, performance measurement, and data-driven optimization. 

• Strong financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource allocation, and business-case development. 

• Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of markets, products, partners, or growth initiatives. 

• Strong full-funnel marketing experience across online and offline channels. 

• Experience developing and executing integrated campaigns tied to measurable business outcomes. 

• Experience in partner marketing and working closely with Sales to drive commercial opportunities. 

• Ability to operate effectively across global and local environments, translating enterprise strategy into market-relevant execution. 

• Proven ability to work with senior corporate, global, North America, and regional leadership. 

• Highly cross-functional, with the ability to bring together teams with different priorities and perspectives. 

• Demonstrated ability to work through complex issues, manage ambiguity, and drive alignment and resolution. 

• Excellent leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills. 

• Results-driven, accountable, and motivated by measurable business impact. 

What Success Looks Like 

• 
• 
• Creating a focused, commercially grounded DACH market strategy. 

• Improving marketing effectiveness, efficiency, and MROI. 

• Driving measurable growth across both sides of the PayPal network. 

• Allocating resources toward the highest-value portfolio opportunities. 

• Strengthening collaboration across global, corporate, North America, and DACH teams. 

• Increasing speed, clarity, and accountability across integrated marketing execution. 

• Developing a high-performing team of commercially minded marketers. 

• Turn customer, partner, and market insights into meaningful business results.

title: Consumer Product Growth Mgr
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

This Consumer Product Owner role (Italy/France/Spain) drives consumer strategy, commercial results, and product performance. You’ll unify PayPal consumer experiences to ensure they work seamlessly together across the market.

The PayPal Consumer team builds products used daily to send, spend, and manage money. You’ll own strategy, roadmap, and delivery for your market, partnering with product, design, engineering, and marketing to drive growth and deliver a best-in-class experience.

Your way to impact:
You’ll lead strategy and execution of initiatives that boost engagement, revenue, and expansion. Working cross-functionally, you’ll build impactful consumer experiences and own key growth levers, accountable for market and enterprise KPIs.

title: Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m)
description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für unser Team in Berlin.

Als Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m) übernimmst Du eine zentrale strategische Führungsrolle: Du transformierst Doctolibs Go-to-Market-Ansatz in Deutschland – und baust einen skalierbaren, quoten-gesteuerten indirekten Vertriebskanal mit IT-Systemhäusern als Kern auf. Du führst ein Team von fünf Mitarbeitenden und baust ein Netzwerk von 50–60 stabilen IT-Systempartnern auf, die gemeinsam mit Doctolib flächendeckend die Digitalisierung des deutschen Gesundheitswesens vorantreiben. Mit Deiner Arbeit schaffst Du einen wachsenden Umsatzpfeiler, der das Direktvertriebsvolumen langfristig ergänzt – und prägst damit maßgeblich die strategische Ausrichtung von Doctolib Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du entwickelst und skalierst einen leistungsstarken indirekten Vertriebskanal mit ausgewählten Top-IT-Systemhäusern (ITSPs) in ganz Deutschland und stellst damit eine flächendeckende regionale Abdeckung sicher

• Du transformierst das bestehende Geschäftsmodell von einem Direktvertriebsmodell zu einem echten indirekten Vertriebskanal mit klaren Quoten, strukturiertem Forecasting und datengetriebenem Performance-Steering

• Du verhandelst und schließt strategische Partnerschaften mit führenden IT-Dienstleistern – inklusive kommerzieller Konstrukte, Priorisierung von Integrationen und konkreter Rollout-Pläne und bist damit mehrere Tage im Monat vor Ort bei den potentiellen Partnern

• Du konzipierst skalierbare Partner-Management-Frameworks, differenzierte Anreizstrukturen und effiziente operative Prozesse für Dein Team

• Du führst, entwickelst und inspirierst ein Team von rund 5 FTEs und baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf Geschäftsführerebene mit den Managing Directors der Systemhauspartner auf

• Du arbeitest eng mit den deutschen Führungsteams aus Sales, Product, Marketing und Tech zusammen und wirkst als Mitglied des German Leadership Teams aktiv an der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von Doctolib Deutschland mit

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

• Mehr als 10 Jahre nachgewiesene Senior-Führungserfahrung im Aufbau und der Skalierung von indirekten Vertriebskanälen und Partnerkanälen – idealerweise in B2B SaaS, Enterprise Software, IT-Lösungen (Cloud Services) oder im IT-Systemhaus-Umfeld

• Tiefgreifende Expertise in der Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Systemhäusern (ITSPs), einschließlich der Gestaltung von Partneranreizprogrammen, kommerziellen Vertragsstrukturen und Deployment-Plänen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Transformation von Vertriebsorganisationen, im Change Management sowie im Aufbau und der Führung von leistungsstarken Sales- und Partnerteams

• Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Begeisterung für den Aufbau von Beziehungen von Grund auf sowie unternehmerisches Denken und hohe Eigeninitiative

• Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, um Vertriebsprozesse zu optimieren, Partnerperformance datenbasiert zu steuern und Dein Team in der Nutzung neuer Technologien weiterzuentwickeln

• Du arbeitest datengetrieben, entwirfst skalierbare Prozesse und iterierst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen

• Du bist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit: Du rekrutierst, coachst und entwickelst Dein Team und schaffst eine leistungsorientierte, motivierende Teamkultur

• Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch auf C1-Niveau

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

• Vorerfahrung im Healthcare- oder Medical-Software-Sektor

• nachgewiesene MRR-Skalierung in einem Multi-Produkt-SaaS-Umfeld

• Erfahrung im Account Management mit kleinen und mittelständischen Unternehmen 

Was wir Dir bieten

• 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

• Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten

• Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

• Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

• Einen Firmenwagen

• Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

• Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

• Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
