title: Lead Marketing Data Analyst (x/f/m)
description:
Vos missions

Nous recherchons un(e) Lead Marketing Data Analyst pour rejoindre l'équipe B2B Performance Marketing. En tant que Lead Marketing Data Analyst, vous êtes la référence analytique de l'équipe sur la performance d'acquisition, l'attribution et la valeur client. 

Vous transformez des données cross-canal complexes en concepts clairs et en recommandations concrètes qui influencent directement les décisions d'investissement, de ciblage et de croissance de l'équipe. Vous êtes le socle data sur lequel s'appuient le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et le Digital Analyst : vous garantissez que la bonne donnée est disponible, fiable et exploitable par tous.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Data Product Managers pour trouver les bonnes solutions et aligner les équipes Data sur des définitions communes, des métriques partagées et une structuration cohérente de la donnée. Vous êtes également le partenaire des Sales Operations (équipe SCOPS) pour construire l'infrastructure de “lead scoring” qui connecte Marketing et Sales.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement AI-first : les modèles ML, les pipelines automatisés et l'analyse assistée par IA feront partie de votre quotidien.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

1. Attribution, parcours de conversion & incrémentalité (30%)

• Piloter le modèle d'attribution multi-touch de l'équipe entre SEO, acquisition payante et CRM

• Construire et maintenir une vue unifiée des parcours de conversion, exploitable depuis le data warehouse

• Définir et documenter les définitions de conversion communes sur lesquelles toute l'équipe s'aligne

• Accompagner les équipes Paid et CRM dans la mesure de leur impact (tests d'incrémentalité, Marketing Mix Modeling, Causal Impact…)

• Travailler avec les Data Product Managers pour s'assurer que les modèles de données et les flux associés sont correctement structurés et maintenus

2. LTV/SAC, analyses de cohortes & reporting à la Direction (25%)

• Suivre la LTV et le SAC par canal d'acquisition, segment et cohorte

• Construire et maintenir les courbes de rétention par cohorte (J7, J30, J90) et identifier les moments de churn

• Déterminer quelles sources d'acquisition et quels segments génèrent la plus forte valeur à long terme

• Développer des modèles de prévision en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Data et Finance

• Produire le reporting LTV/SAC mensuel qui guide les décisions d'allocation budgétaire et préparer les synthèses de performance partagées avec la Direction

3. Scoring des leads & partenariat avec les équipes commerciales (20%)

• Concevoir et déployer un modèle de scoring des leads basé sur le machine learning avec l'équipe SCOPS, pour déterminer quels leads sont transmis aux commerciaux et lesquels sont nurturés en CRM

• Traduire les données comportementales et d'engagement en un modèle de scoring activable dans le CRM, en coordination avec le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI 

• Faire évoluer le modèle au fil des nouvelles données et des retours des équipes commerciales

4. Disponibilité de la donnée & support de l'équipe (15%)

• Être le partenaire data du spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et du Digital Analyst : garantir que la donnée dont ils ont besoin est disponible, bien documentée et fiable

• Traduire leurs besoins en exigences structurées pour les Data Product Managers

• Identifier les problèmes de qualité de données en amont et les suivre jusqu'à leur résolution

• Être le lien entre l'équipe Performance Marketing et l'organisation Data

5. Tableaux de bord opérationnels & suivi de la performance (10%)

• Piloter les tableaux de bord de performance globale de l'équipe : acquisition, attribution, LTV/SAC et contribution par canal (suivi quotidien, pilotage hebdomadaire, vue mensuelle pour la direction)

• Mettre en place une détection automatique des anomalies, des synthèses narratives générées par IA et des analyses exploratoires assistées pour libérer du temps sur des travaux analytiques à plus forte valeur ajoutée

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

• Justifiez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience en analytics marketing, growth analytics ou business analytics idéalement dans des scale-ups B2B SaaS

• Avez l'habitude de piloter un travail analytique de bout en bout, du modèle de données à la présentation à la Direction

• Maîtrisez les requêtes SQL de manière autonome au quotidien et avez travaillé directement avec BigQuery ou équivalent

• Avez une expérience concrète en attribution et/ou en incrémentalité : vous avez construit ou piloté un modèle d'attribution multi-touch, mené des tests d'incrémentalité (user-based, geolift) ou travaillé sur du Marketing Mix Modeling

• Avez une expérience en optimisation du funnel marketing :

• Stratégie d'acquisition & d'activation

• Modélisation de la LTV / SAC dans un contexte SaaS ou par abonnement : avoir réalisé des analyses LTV et SAC basées sur des cohortes, utilisées pour orienter l'allocation budgétaire ou des décisions stratégiques.

• Définition des KPIs et cadre de référence (MQLs, SQLs, Leads...)

• Expérience avec des outils de visualisation de données : Amplitude, Tableau, Looker, Metabase…

• Maîtrisez l'anglais et le français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral

Ce serait fantastique si vous aviez aussi :

• Des compétences en Python ou R pour la modélisation statistique avancée et le développement de modèles de machine learning

• Une connaissance des modèles de croissance tirés par le produit (product-led growth) et de la façon dont les données d'usage alimentent la mesure marketing

• Une expérience de management ou d'accompagnement d'analystes plus juniors

• Des notions d'allemand

Notre offre

• Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care

• 10 jours par an de télétravail à l’étranger possible

• Adhésion au plan de partage de la valeur de Doctolib, appelé DoctoGrowth

• Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,50 € par jour, dont 4,50 € pris en charge par Doctolib

• Une subvention du comité d’entreprise pour le remboursement d'une partie de l'inscription à un club de sport ou à une activité créative

• Un mois de congé supplémentaire au congé parental légal grâce au programme "Parent Care"

• Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien psychologique renforcé

title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four

• Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard

• Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities

• Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity

• Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature

• Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

Unser Ziel ist es, die Markteinführung neuer Produkte strategisch zu steuern und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Angebote echten Mehrwert für Gesundheitsfachkräfte und Patient:innen schaffen. • Du verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils min. C1)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

• Erfahrungen aus Beratung, Start-ups oder vergleichbaren Tätigkeitsfeldern

• Interesse oder erste Erfahrungen im Gesundheitswesen

• Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder die Übernahme Deines Semestertickets

• 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr (anteilig auf Deine Arbeitszeiten berechnet)

• Regelmäßige Frühstücksangebote im Büro, sowie Bezuschussungen zu Deinem Lebensmitteleinkauf

• Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Paris (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.

Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.

Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

• Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification

• Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan

• Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

• Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

• Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

• You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period

• You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer

• You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion

• You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

• You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain

• You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

• Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel

• Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints

• Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context

What we offer

• Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

• 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

• Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

• Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

• Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

• A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

• 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

• ParentCare Program: full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

• Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

• For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

• Relocation support in case of international mobility

• Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

• Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime)

• Hiring Manager Interview (Louis Durteste) 

• Case Study with Product Panel

• Behavioral Interview

• At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Description de l'équipe

Vous êtes passionné(e) par les innovations en santé ? Rejoignez l'équipe Marketing Patient France Doctolib, où de nombreux projets innovants sont en cours de développement pour aider les patients à prendre soin d'eux. C'est le moment idéal pour intégrer notre équipe et contribuer à des initiatives stratégiques qui auront un impact direct sur la santé des patients.

title: Associate Director Marketing Lifecycle, CC outbound
description:
The role

The Associate Director for Lifecycle, CC Outbound, owns the outbound call center channel strategy and performance for millions of former customers across all 17 of our international markets and all our brands. We are looking for a CRM expert, who is interested in running strategy for Call Center, with a high level of autonomy and agility. You will own the strategic development, performance and strategic innovations for this channel, working closely with the Call Center Operations team. Your scope includes steering performance and managing budgets, implementing strategies that will unlock a better customer experience, under consideration of country-specific idiosyncrasies. It also means developing this channel into one of our prime sources of insight to customer sentiment and inspiration for product improvements at scale (e.g., through the use of AI tools). Moreover, you will own the performance of this channel, which includes setting targets together with our local market CMOs and day-to-day steering of conversions, cost and ROI together with our VP of customer care and his operations managers. 

If you want to own a critical channel for one of our most valuable customer groups and develop a strong muscle in driving CRM strategy and execution, we want to hear from you!

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

• Develop and implement annual strategic plans for Call Centre Outbound initiatives

• Manage the CC Outbound for the full customer lifecycle, from leads to reactivation

• Collaborate with CC Operations, cross-functional teams, local markets and international marketing leadership to align strategies with overall business goals.

• Experience in and a passion for delivering excellent and effective customer experiences (e.g., working in CRM/Lifecycle Marketing, campaign management, Product, etc.)

• Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to influence and motivate people at all levels within international environments and across a broad variety of job functions.

• Strong ownership mentality and drive to deliver results, including experience with prioritizing for highest impact and managing trade-off decisions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from data

• Ideally hands-on experience working with or in Call Centres

• Ideally experience in Experimentation/Testing

title: Creative Strategy Lead, New Social Growth Platforms (all genders)
description:
The role

Meta is our core social channel, but the next leg of growth depends on what's around it. The 2026 ambition is clear: scale TikTok into our #2 social channel on incrementality-steered investment, and prove Pinterest, Snap, and other emerging platforms on the same evidence bar.

This role owns that diversification agenda end-to-end. You're the in-house expert on TikTok — its algorithm, Spark Ads, TikTok Creative Exchange, and the 2–3 day creative fatigue window that punishes slow teams. You also drive structured pilots on Pinterest and Snap: technical setup, account architecture, creative strategy tailored to each platform, and the incrementality tests that decide whether we scale or shut down. You don't run media for these channels in BAU mode — you build the playbook, prove the channel works, then hand a mature operation over to the broader team

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

• TikTok scale-up. Set TikTok as a native-first growth engine. Own account architecture, bidding, audience strategy, and the creative cadence the platform demands. Partner with TikTok directly — joint steering committee, beta access, TTCX program, Managed Services — to unlock funding and capability gaps.

• TikTok creative strategy. The single biggest lever on TikTok is platform-native creative. Define the briefing approach with the Creative Strategist and Influencer team, scale Spark Ads and creator partnerships, and build the iteration cadence the 2–3 day fatigue window requires. Push the team away from "repurposed Reels" toward TikTok-first concepts.

• Pinterest and Snap pilots. Run structured launch playbooks for each: signal infrastructure (CAPI, pixel, EMQ), account setup, creative strategy fit-for-platform, market selection, and a clean incrementality test (CLS or geo) before we commit a real budget. Same rigor for Reddit if/when it earns its slot.

• Incrementality and effectiveness. Design and run the conversion lift / geo experiments that determine which channels stay, scale, or sunset. Calibrate MMM with each result.

• Channel-by-channel measurement. Own the data foundation across emerging channels — overlap analysis with Meta, audience cannibalization, true incremental CAC. Build the case (or the kill memo) with evidence, not platform-reported numbers.

• Future-channel scouting. Stay ahead on what's next — Reddit, ChatGPT/Copilot Ads, retail media, emerging short-video platforms. Maintain a prioritized backlog and a clear bar for what earns a pilot slot.

• Handover and scaling. Once a channel is proven and operationalized, transition BAU execution to the broader paid social team with documented playbooks, while staying accountable for the next bet.

What you’ll bring

• 5+ years in paid social or performance marketing, with deep hands-on TikTok Ads Manager fluency at a high-spend D2C, subscription, or e-commerce business. You've personally scaled a TikTok account from low single-digit % of spend into a meaningful contributor.

• Working knowledge of Pinterest Ads Manager and Snap Ads Manager — or a credible track record of taking a new platform from zero to scale, fast.

• Strong incrementality and experimentation muscle — you can design a CLS or geo test, defend the methodology, and read the result without spinning it.

• Sharp creative instinct for short-form video and platform-native content. You know why a TikTok hook is different from a Reels hook, and can brief and review against that.

• Comfortable building from scratch — pixel setup, account architecture, partner relationships, internal stakeholder buy-in. This role has more zero-to-one work than steady-state.

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

• You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.

• Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.

• Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.

Health & Wellbeing

• Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.

• Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Flexibility & Work-Life

• Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.

• Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.

• Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Career & Development

• Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Culture & Environment

• Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.

• We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

title: Senior CRM Manager - Transformation (all genders)
description:
The role

We are looking for a Senior CRM Manager - Transformation to make CRM Self-Service at HelloFresh a reality.

Our central Growth function has a clear vision: Enabling our local marketing and product teams to reach our customers directly, via push notifications, in-app messaging and emails. For this to work in an efficient and customer-centric way, the right guardrails, tools and knowledge need to be in place.

Your first mission is to design, launch and scale our CRM self-service model. You’ll do this hand in hand with our CreativeTech squad (Product and Engineering), who are building the future CRM environment in an AI-native way. You’ll work closely with the squad, and potentially be embedded in it. You’ll be the voice of CRM and of our internal users, helping define what this environment needs to look like so teams can send communications safely and independently.

This is 0-to-1 work in a highly ambiguous space where no one has been before: no playbook, no rules. AI and LLMs change fast and often, so you’ll think about what we need in the future, even if today’s models aren’t ready yet, and be prepared for when they catch up. The learning curve will be steep, but you’ll climb it on the go, together with the team. Our goal: protect our environment from the agents, and protect the agents from our environment. 

From there, your focus will follow where CRM needs it most. You’ll take on further transformation projects, so this role is for someone who enjoys building something new and then moving on to the next challenge.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

• Lead the self-service rollout: Take end-to-end ownership of the programme, from framing the scope and aligning stakeholders to launching and tracking adoption

• Shape the future CRM platform: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to define how our agentic CRM environment should work, bringing in the needs of users and helping prioritise what gets built next 

• Steer CRM Agents: Build the skills and context agents need to create campaigns reliably, on brand and within our guardrails 

• Build frameworks and playbooks: Develop the documentation, training and processes that let teams send safely without central support

• Enable the teams: Design and run user centric training and onboarding for local marketing and product teams, and turn user feedback into improvements

• Make performance visible: Define and create reportings to measure success

• Scale what works: Identify new use cases to move to self-service and manage each transition end to end

title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do

• Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.

• Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.

• Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.

• Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.

• Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.

• Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.

• Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.

• Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.

• As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

• A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.

• 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.

• Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.

• A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.

• Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.

• Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.

• A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.

• Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).

• A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.

• Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.

Nice to have:

• Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.

• Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.

• Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.

• GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
HelloFresh Ireland is in an exciting growth phase - expanding customer choice, deepening menu relevance, and driving long-term loyalty in a fast-growing market. As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the product space, driving impact across product strategy, product operations, and culinary workstreams. You will lead a talented, dedicated team and serve as the strategic engine behind what makes our boxes brilliant for Irish customers.

This is not a technology product role. You will work across the full physical product value chain and lifecycle - from ingredient sourcing and culinary development through to menu strategy, editorial execution, and customer experience - making decisions that directly impact what lands on our customers' doorsteps every week. You will need the ability to operate at pace, cut through complexity, and bring teams and stakeholders with you.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Strategic business planning: Reviewing product KPIs and guiding the team to improve the product offering - balancing short-term operations with long-term strategic direction, and owning the product investment calendar to increase retention while optimising for revenue and costs.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating and building strong relationships with Operations, Marketing, and international teams - being the voice of the physical product for HelloFresh Ireland, advising on coherent processes between functions, and ensuring a coordinated approach to product initiatives across local and global stakeholders.

• Process optimisation: Identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve how we work - across teams and with key partners - and aligning operational improvements with the strategic direction.

• Analytical decision making: Working with the team to ensure access to the relevant information, analyses, and insights needed to make informed product development decisions and translate the product vision into action.

• Business case development: Developing business cases around physical product improvements and product-related processes (e.g. changes in product offering, tooling, and automations), and making data-led recommendations to Ireland and global teams.

• People management: Leading, developing and inspiring teams spanning Culinary, Physical Product Strategy, and Product Operations - setting clear strategic direction, cultivating a high-performing culture, and supporting each team member's growth across different career stages.

Who You Are:

• Senior experience in product, category, or commercial - ideally food, FMCG, meal kits, or subscription.

• A genuine passion for food, with the ability to translate taste trends and market signals into compelling product offerings.

• Proven people leadership across different career stages - coaching, clear direction, and investment in growth.

• Strong commercial acumen - connecting product decisions to business outcomes including revenue and retention.

• Excellent cross-functional influence - aligning teams toward a shared goal without needing formal authority.

• Organised and structured, with strong project management skills and the ability to deliver to tight deadlines.

• Strong analytical skills - able to drill into detail, connect findings to the big picture, and present insights clearly.

• Customer-centric, with creative thinking to identify unmet needs and develop solutions that address them.

• A bias for action - moving quickly without sacrificing quality, bringing momentum to the teams around you.

• Sharp problem-solving instincts - comfortable with ambiguity and confident driving toward solutions.

• At home in lean, agile environments - able to do more with less and build from the ground up.

• Comfortable in Excel and Google Suite.

• The chance to have a serious impact on one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Europe in an exciting growth phase

• Direct, high impact on our Operations setup from day one

• A vibrant, international environment with mission-driven colleagues

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

As Growth Manager, EMEA, you'll drive capital-efficient growth across our EMEA marketplace; owning cross market growth and optimization initiatives end-to-end. This is a highly analytical, cross-functional role: you'll dig into data to find where growth is being left on the table, turn that into tested and scaled solutions, and enjoy the kind of ambiguous, hard-to-crack growth problems that don't come with an existing playbook.

Reporting to the Head of EMEA Growth and being part of a 3-person team, you will play a key role finding and closing growth gaps across the region, working closely with the Growth Product, Analytics, and Marketing teams.

What you’ll be doing

• Own goal-setting and efficiency tracking for growth initiatives, using data to find where growth is being left on the table

• Own growth budget efficiency and ROI — spot what's underperforming and fix it, whether that means reallocating spend, running a new experiment, or changing the process

• Partner cross-functionally with Growth Product, Analytics, and Marketing to scope, prioritize, and ship both new growth initiatives and improvements to existing ones

• Drive growth partnerships to success — spot what's not performing, and push the changes that fix it

Our humble expectations*

• Previous experience in consumer or marketplace business, product operations, growth, marketing, or management consulting.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze and interpret data to inform decisions.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

• Fluent with AI tools and comfortable weaving them into your everyday workflow.

• Comfortable moving between deep analytical work and cross-functional collaboration

• Genuine enjoyment of ambiguous, hard-to-crack growth problems that don't come with an existing playbook

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

At DoorDash International, we're building the future of local commerce across some of Europe's leading delivery businesses, including Wolt and Deliveroo. Our teams work across brands and markets to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions and turn global capabilities into meaningful local impact.

Why Join Us?

At DoorDash International, execution drives impact. We combine the scale and technology of a global platform with a deep understanding of our local markets. You'll work across Wolt and Deliveroo, partnering with teams throughout EMEA markets to solve complex business problems and scale what works.

If you're passionate about using data to identify growth opportunities, turning insights into action and working across markets to drive measurable business impact, this is an opportunity to help shape how we grow our Restaurant business through better menus.

What you'll be doing

We are seeking a Menu Growth Senior Specialist to support Restaurant growth by improving restaurant Menu Performance and driving adoption of menu-related growth initiatives across EMEA.

Menus are a critical part of the customer and merchant experience. Their quality, completeness and use of growth features can influence customer choice, basket size and overall merchant performance.

You will work closely with the Menu Growth Manager to analyze menu performance, identify opportunities and translate insights into concrete initiatives. You will take end-to-end ownership of defined workstreams, such as Menu Completeness, and work with local Account Management and Merchant Operations teams to execute them across markets and measure their impact.

This is a hands-on Strategy & Operations role combining analytics, project management and stakeholder collaboration. You will independently drive your initiatives from analysis through execution and performance tracking, while partnering with the Menu Growth Manager and Consumer Teams on broader strategy and prioritization.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

Menu Growth Analysis (~30%)

• Analyze consumer needs around menu, merchant and business performance to identify gaps and growth opportunities.

• Use SQL, Snowflake, spreadsheets and dashboards to investigate performance and support data-driven decision-making.

• Work with the Menu Growth Manager to turn insights and hypotheses into concrete initiatives.

• Track key metrics including and identify markets or merchant segments requiring additional focus.

• Support impact measurement and experimentation to understand which interventions improve merchant and business outcomes.

• Prepare clear analyses and recommendations that help EMEA and local teams make informed decisions.

Initiative Execution (~45%)

• Own defined Menu Growth initiatives end-to-end, from planning through market rollout and performance tracking.

• Support the rollout and adoption of EMEA initiatives

• Translate initiatives into clear execution plans, timelines, materials and actions for participating markets.

• Track progress against agreed targets and proactively identify execution gaps or blockers.

• Coordinate follow-ups with local teams and support them in implementing agreed actions.

• Measure results, document learnings and recommend improvements together with the Menu Growth Manager.

• Help scale successful approaches and best practices across EMEA markets.

Market & Stakeholder Collaboration (~25%)

• Work closely with local Account Management and Merchant Operations teams and their leaders across EMEA.

• Support markets in understanding menu performance gaps and translating insights into concrete actions.

• Build strong relationships with local stakeholders to drive adoption and execution of Menu Growth initiatives.

• Gather structured market feedback and use it to improve future initiatives.

• Coordinate with Analytics and Product when initiatives require additional data, insights or tooling support.

• Share successful approaches and learnings across markets to accelerate adoption and reduce duplicated effort.

Our humble expectations

• 2–4 years of experience in Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Marketplace/Commercial Operations or a comparable analytical role.

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations.

• Comfortable working with large datasets, SQL/Snowflake, Excel/Google Sheets and BI/dashboarding tools.

• Familiarity with hypothesis-driven problem solving, experimentation and A/B testing principles.

• First project management experience, with the ability to independently drive defined initiatives from analysis through execution.

• A commercial mindset and curiosity about how merchant and customer behavior translates into business growth.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and a proactive, action-oriented approach to driving execution across teams and markets.

• Fluent business English; experience in marketplaces, food delivery, e-commerce or high-growth tech is a plus.

What we offer

• A fast-growing tech company with lots of career opportunities, both locally and internationally;

• Employee Assistance Programme - therapy and wellbeing;

• Employee discount on all Wolt orders;

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going! 

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

description:

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

• Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

• Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

• Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

• Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

• Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

• You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

• You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

• You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

• You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

• You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

• You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

• You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Lead Product Manager, DeFi
description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

• Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.

• Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.

• Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.

• Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.

• Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

• 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.

• You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.

• Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.

• Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.

• Nice to haves: 

• hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch

• knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available remotely in one of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

• You are a strong cross-functional leader capable of guiding analysts while fostering tight partnerships with Data, Finance, Product, and channel owners.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

title: Lifecycle Manager
description:
About the opportunity

As a Lifecycle Manager, you will take ownership of the lifecycle communication strategy for a core domain within our Lifecycle team. In this role, you will bridge customer insight and business growth by translating analytics into impactful customer journeys, optimising customer Lifetime Value (LTV), and accelerating Primary Account adoption. Partnering closely with Product Marketing and leveraging modern automation, predictive models, and emerging AI tools, you will lead high-impact campaigns while maintaining operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

In this role, you will:

• Own and evolve the lifecycle communication strategy within your focus domain to drive user engagement, activation, and long-term retention. 

• Collaborate closely with Analytics teams to decode customer behaviour, extract actionable conclusions, and transform insights into effective campaign strategies.

• Partner with Product Marketing to translate complex product features and benefits into clear, compelling customer messaging. 

• Design and execute targeted initiatives focused on optimising customer Lifetime Value (LTV) and driving Primary Account adoption. 

• Proactively identify new growth opportunities, taking full ownership to push strategic initiatives forward across cross-functional teams. 

• Champion innovation by integrating AI agents and automated workflow tools to streamline campaign execution and elevate personalisation. 

• Establish holistic A/B testing frameworks and longitudinal experimentation models to continuously measure LTV impact. 

• Serve as a key CRM voice for senior leadership, translating campaign performance into high-level business insights.

What you need to be successful:

• 6+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or customer growth roles.

• Proven track record of developing multi-channel lifecycle strategies that deliver measurable impact on engagement, retention, and LTV.

• High drive and an entrepreneurial spirit, acting as a self-starter who actively spots hidden opportunities and takes initiative to drive them to completion.

• Strong analytical acumen with a proven ability to interpret customer data, digest analytical reports, and make data-backed conclusions.

• Exceptional collaborative skills, with experience partnering alongside Product Marketing, Analytics, and Creative teams.

• Forward-thinking, innovative mindset with an enthusiasm for leveraging modern technology, including AI agents and automated workflow solutions.

• Hands-on proficiency with customer engagement platforms (Braze experience is a strong plus) alongside collaboration tools like Figma and Jira.

• Solid understanding of data privacy rules (GDPR) and regulatory requirements within customer communications.

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

title: Consumer Insights Manager
description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Your Mission

You’ll turn customer and brand research into clear, decision-ready insights — leading select studies end-to-end, keeping our brand health reporting sharp, and partnering closely with the Head of Global Customer & Market Insights to advance the wider learning agenda.

What you’ll do

• Lead research projects end-to-end: drivers/barriers, Category Entry Points, message/concept testing, segmentation, and ad/campaign measurement — choosing the right method and balancing rigor vs. speed for each brief.

• Keep brand health measurement running smoothly: maintain the tracking dashboards and reporting cadence.

• Contribute to the learning agenda: help map knowledge gaps in your focus areas, propose and prioritize research questions.

• Support Creative, Supply Marketing and PR: design and run dedicated pre/post studies, help with partner selection, and prepare campaign readouts that sharpen strategy and creative.

• Make insights accessible and actionable: produce crisp one-pagers and exec summaries for your studies, contribute to “insights roadshows,” and help maintain a searchable insights library.

• Help modernize the toolkit: pilot AI-assisted analysis and synthesis tools, test new methods, and share what works with the wider team.

• Build strong working relationships across Brand, PR/Comms, Data/Analytics, CRM, and UXR representing insights confidently in your own projects and forums.

• Partner with and support the Head of Global Customer & Market Insights on key strategic initiatives: prepare materials for exec and leadership audiences, help drive cross-functional alignment, and step in to represent the function when needed.

• Coordinate with our research freelancer and help brief and manage agencies on assigned projects (scoping, timelines, SOWs).

• Champion ethics and quality: uphold research best practices, privacy, and inclusive, unbiased language in surveys and stimuli.

Your Toolkit

• 5+ years in insights, research, strategy, or brand analytics (agency or client-side); travel, marketplace, or consumer tech experience is a plus, not a must

• A track record of running well-designed studies independently and translating mixed signals (reports, trackers, qual/quant) into simple, decision-ready recommendations.

• Solid research craft: writing tight briefs, sound method design and sampling, avoiding bias, and storytelling with evidence.

• Strong communication skills: you translate data into “so what / now what” and adjust depth for execs vs. working teams.

• Initiative and ownership: you drive your projects independently, while knowing when to loop in the Head or escalate a decision.

• A collaborative mindset: you build trust and alignment with stakeholders across functions, even under competing priorities.

• Curiosity: you test new tools and methods and keep an eye on industry thinking (behavioral science, jobs-to-be-done, consumer psychology).

• Hands-on with survey platforms and trackers; comfortable with BI tools (e.g., Looker/GA), spreadsheets, and light stats. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis and synthesis.

• Experience running (or closely supporting) segmentation, brand/creative testing, and campaign effectiveness studies.

• Some experience briefing or coordinating freelancers or agencies on individual projects.

• Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

How we’ll measure impact

• Quality, rigor and timeliness of the studies you lead; stakeholder satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) with your work.

• Brand health reporting delivered accurately and on schedule, with issues flagged early.

• Adoption of your insights by stakeholders — “insights-to-action” in your projects.

• Visible contribution to the wider learning agenda and to initiatives led by the Head of Global Customer & Market Insights.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

• Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

• Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

• A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. 

• Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with a quarterly team event budget 

• Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them

• Monthly transportation and fitness budget

• Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

• Language reimbursement program

• Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How to apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

title: Director of Partnerships
description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

The Team Mission

Strategic Partnerships is GetYourGuide's partner distribution channel. It generates a significant share of the company's revenue, with a team of 30 people across EMEA, the Americas and APAC. A dedicated partnership tech team sits in Product and Engineering; the Partnerships Director sets its product strategy.

Partners include online travel platforms, banks and loyalty programs, affiliate networks, travel agents and more. The ambition is to triple the channel within three years. That means changing how the channel operates, not optimizing the current momentum.

Your Mission

We are hiring a director-level leader to run the Partnerships function. You will set the strategy for growing the partner channel, set the product direction for the partner platform, and directly lead teams across sales, account management, and strategy and operations. The function was brought together in 2026 from two teams and is being rebuilt around partner segments. You get to shape it from close to the ground up, with the COO as your sponsor, and you run it end to end from day one.

This is a highly visible role based in Berlin, working in a hybrid model. We offer a competitive relocation package to support your move—successful candidates will be expected to be based in Berlin or happy to relocate.

What you will own

• A high-revenue channel and its P&L. You set targets, own the forecast and partner economics, and run execution across EMEA, the Americas and APAC.

• The strategy for how GetYourGuide wins through partners. You decide where we play and how we win in each segment, from global OTAs and loyalty programs to affiliate and travel-agent programs, and you make the calls on what we will not do.

• The largest partnerships in travel. You personally lead negotiations with our largest partners and set terms that hold as volume scales.

• The supply story. GetYourGuide has one of the largest experiences inventories in the market. You decide how we use it commercially with partners: what we offer exclusively, where, and on what terms.

• The product direction for the partner platform. Partner technology is built in Product, but you set what it builds: the segment problems worth solving, the research behind them, and the roadmap they add up to.

• A team of about 30, and its next shape. Regional leads, segment owners and a central RevOps team. You design the org, decide your leadership bench and raise the bar.

• The operating rhythm. QBRs, metrics and prioritization that turn strategy into quarters of growth.

Must-haves

• 15+ years of experience, ideally at VP or Director level, within a B2B SaaS or marketplace environment. Experience in Business Development and/or Revenue Operations (RevOps) is a plus

• Business unit leadership, not only sales leadership. You have run a commercial P&L that combined several go-to-market motions (enterprise business development, account management, programmatic long-tail programs) and a team of 20 or more.

• Strategy authorship. You have written a channel or segment strategy with clear choices and trade-offs, and then executed it.

• Dealmaking. You have personally negotiated complex commercial agreements with large partners and can point to the terms.

• People leadership. A track record of recruiting, developing and retaining strong commercial talent, including managing managers.

• Product fluency. You can translate partner needs into problem statements a product team can prioritize, and you have worked closely with product and engineering leaders before.

• Analytical rigor. You read the data yourself, challenge inconsistencies, and diagnose funnel and unit-economics problems.

• Execution discipline. A high say-do ratio, sustained through an operating cadence rather than heroics.

• Communication. You negotiate, influence and build relationships at C-level with partners and internally.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience at scale ups or B2B Saas

• Marketplace or two-sided business experience.

• Experience with affiliate, loyalty or fintech partnerships.

title: Lead Product Manager, User Platform
description:
Change the way the world travels

GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. Since its founding in 2009, people from all over the world have booked more than 150 million tours, activities, and attraction tickets through GetYourGuide. Powered by a global team of over 1000 travel experts and technologists, we are headquartered in Berlin and have 17 local offices around the world. Visit our careers website to learn more.

Team mission

GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.

Your mission

As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.

The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.

We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.

What You'll Do 

• Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.

• Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.

• Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.

• Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.

• Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.

• Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.

• Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.

• Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products

Your toolkit

• 6+ years of professional experience in product management, including at least 2 years at Lead level or with equivalent scope, and meaningful time spent on data, machine learning or platform products

• Demonstrated ownership of a product area whose users are other teams, such as an internal platform, an API or a data product, including strategy, KPI definition, goal setting and adoption, not only delivery

• Strong data literacy: comfortable querying and interpreting large datasets, designing experiments, and working day to day with data scientists and analysts

• A working understanding of the machine learning lifecycle and how it differs from software delivery, plus the judgment to know when analytics and good heuristics are the better answer

• A track record of building alignment across a large and varied set of stakeholders, including senior leadership, in a way that is consistent with our Guiding Principles

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Bonus: experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation or personalization systems

• Bonus: experience putting LLMs into production
