title: Senior Product Manager - AI Gateway
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.



The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.





MAKE DAY-ONE SUCCESS THE DEFAULT

 - Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.

 - Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.

 - Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..




BUILD AND RUN PROVIDER PARTNERSHIPS

 - Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.

 - Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.

 - Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.

 - Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.




SHAPE THE ENTERPRISE AI GATEWAY

 - Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.

 - Turn what you learn into a clear product strategy, and be honest about what to build, what to pause and what to stop.

 - Define the core capabilities: virtual keys, budgets and spend limits, model access policies, usage reporting and audit.

 - Consider how the gateway works for self-hosted and Cloud customers. Work closely with engineering and our Cloud team on deployment questions.

 - Help define how the enterprise gateway is packaged and sold, together with Sales, Finance and leadership.




LEAD ACROSS TEAMS

 - Work with a dedicated engineering team, and with design, as one product team.

 - Coordinate with teams that own nearby areas, such as identity and access management, governance, billing and the Cloud experience.

 - Keep leadership, Sales and Customer Success informed, and bring them clear recommendations.




REQUIREMENTS




MUST-HAVES

 - Experience as a PM for AI infrastructure, developer platforms or LLM tooling (for example AI gateways, model APIs, or AI platform products), or for enterprise admin and governance products (for example access control, policy, spend management or audit).

 - Hands-on experience with partner or vendor deals: you have negotiated terms, not only managed relationships.

 - A strong grasp of usage-based pricing, unit costs and consumption forecasting.

 - Comfort talking with enterprise buyers: platform engineers, security teams and IT leaders.

 - Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

 - Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

 - Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition 




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - You have built or run an LLM gateway or proxy, or worked closely with tools like LiteLLM, Portkey or similar.

 - Experience with products that run both self-hosted and as SaaS.

 - You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.

 - You’ve worked on products involving third-party APIs, authentication, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems.

 - You’ve built products alongside developer communities, contributors, or external ecosystems.



Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the heart of the product experience - shaping how builders go from an idea to a workflow they trust in production. Your work will influence some of the most fundamental parts of n8n: how people build, connect services, access powerful capabilities, understand what’s happening in their workflows, and scale from simple automation to complex AI-powered systems.



You’ll join n8n at a stage where the product and company are scaling rapidly, but there is still enormous opportunity to define what a world-class automation building experience should feel like. You’ll have the autonomy to identify important problems, work deeply with users and technical teams, and turn ambitious ideas into product experiences people rely on every day.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?



Apply now - and help us build the future of automation

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! BENEFITS

ABOUT CODEWAY

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale. 

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two. 

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us. 

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space. 

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.  

Turns out you can do both. 

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.



POSITION

At Codeway, we're redefining the performance marketing role. Here, you won't just analyze data and optimize campaigns; you'll also participate in creative discussions, manage global network relationships, and contribute to strategic decisions that shape Codeway’s future vision.


 

The ideal candidate is sharp, curious and hard-working, whether they’re a recent graduate or already have some growth experience. They’ve done their homework on the app industry, are creatively open-minded.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Experience. You’re a recent graduate (bachelor’s or master’s) or already have hands-on experience in growth or performance marketing. Either way, you’re eager to learn fast and grow in this field.

 - Structured thinking. When something changes, you want to understand why before you react. You use data to solve problems, not just to report on them.

 - Take the wheel. You’re hard-working and a fast learner. You teach yourself new things without being told, and you don’t give up until you get there.

 - Done your homework. You’ve tried our apps and have your own opinions on how apps grow and make money.

 - Creative eye. You notice what makes an ad or a piece of content work, and you bring fresh ideas.

 - Ownership. You’ve started or run something (a club, a project, an event or an initiative at work), not just joined it. Here you won’t be a newcomer; you’ll own your thing.

 - AI-curious. You already use AI tools for school, work or your own projects.

 - Cool vibe. You have a low ego and communicate clearly. You ask early, take feedback well, and work easily with marketing artists, product managers and external partners.

 - Excellent command of English. You’ll manage a creative pipeline that mainly targets the United States audience, and manage joint partnerships with external networks and agencies.
   WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience. You have 0-2 years of experience, are eager to take your first steps in this field, and are open to learning.

 - Passion. Passion for mobile marketing, data, creative production.

 - Take the wheel. You’re ready to get your hands dirty. You’re hard-working, you refuse to give up until achieving what you want to get. You’re result-driven and always aim for excellence in the work you do.

 - Ownership. We want you to be ready to own every aspect of your project. You won’t be a newcomer here; you’ll own your thing.

 - Cool vibe. You’re open to constructive criticism and feedback. You’re ready to improve yourself accordingly.

 - Excellent communication skills. You’ll wear multiple hats as you work with marketing artists, product managers, external partners, and your peers within the performance team.

 - Excellent command of English. You’ll manage a creative pipeline that mainly targets the United States audience, and manage joint partnerships with external networks and agencies.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive Compensation. Because great work deserves great pay.

 - Full Private Health Insurance. Unlimited coverage.

 - Free Breakfast & Lunch. Every day at Codebrew, our in-office coffee shop, with barista coffee and healthy snacks all day long.

 - Meal & Transport Support. Monthly compensation that actually covers a proper lunch and your daily commute.

 - A Top-Notch Office. In the iconic Edifici Estel, right in the heart of Barcelona.

 - Flexible Schedule. We care about your impact, not about tracking your minutes.

 - Top Tech Setup. From a high-end laptop to the software and gadgets that help you thrive.

 - Wellbeing & Growth. Gym membership, English & Spanish course support, and a game corner for well-earned breaks.

AI won’t be a feature you’ll add to an existing product. It will be the foundation of everything you build. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, growth, data, and our AI research teams to explore both frontier proprietary models and open-source technologies, turning breakthroughs in image and video generation into products that people genuinely love using.

This role is for builders.

People who enjoy creating clarity from ambiguity. Who are comfortable making decisions without perfect information. Who care as much about finding the right problem as building the right solution.

The roadmap isn’t written yet.

You’ll help write it.

◦ Build a new AI product around image and video generation from zero alongside a small cross-functional team.

◦ Discover meaningful user problems through research, observation, and direct conversations.

◦ Turn emerging AI capabilities into simple, intuitive product experiences that solve real user needs.

◦ Build MVPs, launch quickly, validate ideas, and iterate relentlessly based on user feedback and data.

◦ Evaluate the latest image and video generation models, understanding their strengths, limitations, and where they create meaningful product opportunities.

◦ Design experiments that accelerate learning and help the team reach product-market fit faster.

◦ Work closely with engineering, design, growth, data, and AI research to ship continuously.

◦ Balance user value, technical feasibility, model capabilities, and business impact in every product decision.

◦ Help define the long-term direction of a product from its earliest days.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

◦ You’ve built products from zero to one—whether at an early-stage startup, inside a larger company, or as a founder.

◦ You’re energised by ambiguity and enjoy creating structure where none exists.

◦ You naturally move between strategy and execution. You’re just as happy interviewing users or reviewing AI outputs as you are analysing experiments or defining the next milestone.

◦ You have exceptional product taste and a high bar for user experience. You care about the details because you know they’re often what make products feel magical.

◦ You’re deeply curious about AI, particularly image and video generation, and you’re excited by how rapidly the technology is evolving.

◦ You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across product, engineering, design, data, and AI research.

◦ You take ownership naturally and care far more about outcomes than outputs.

 


NICE-TO-HAVE

◦ Experience as a founder or founding Product Manager.

◦ Experience building AI-powered consumer products.

◦ Experience launching a new product from zero to one.

◦ Experience working closely with ML engineers or AI research teams.

THE RECRUITING PROCESS

We are committed to keeping our recruitment process short and transparent. Here’s how it looks like:

 1. Application: Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You can also just write a few words about yourself.

 2. Talent & Culture Interview: Let’s talk about your experience & expectations and see what we can achieve together.

title: Associate Growth Manager
description:
ABOUT CODEWAY

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale. 

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two. 

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us. 

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space. 

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.  

Turns out you can do both. 

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.



POSITION

At Codeway, we're redefining the performance marketing role. Here, you won't just analyze data and optimize campaigns; you'll also participate in creative discussions, manage global network relationships, and contribute to strategic decisions that shape Codeway’s future vision.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional all-rounder: good with people, comfortable with data, a self-starter who’s not afraid of failing, capable of generating creative ad ideas, and deeply curious about all aspects of growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Claim 360 ownership of an app’s marketing & execute end-to-end user acquisition strategies.

 - Manage the Creative Pipeline. Develop and test creatives: come up with ideas, propose hypotheses, monitor implementation, and give feedback. 

 - Manage and optimize user acquisition campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Google and other networks.

 - Build meaningful relationships with external partners and agencies, and manage collaborations with ad networks such as Meta London, TikTok Dubai, Apple London, and Google Dublin teams.

 - Build and monitor BI dashboards for insights, and ensure campaigns achieve target KPIs while scaling.

 - Collaborate closely with the product team to understand user motivations and shape effective monetization strategies.

 - Take additional responsibilities to grow your app. Get creative, think beyond performance marketing, and apply out-of-the-box growth-hacking techniques.
   
   



WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience. You have 0-2 years of experience, are eager to take your first steps in this field, and are open to learning.

 - Passion. Passion for mobile marketing, data, creative production.

 - Take the wheel. You’re ready to get your hands dirty. You’re hard-working, you refuse to give up until achieving what you want to get. You’re result-driven and always aim for excellence in the work you do.

 - Ownership. We want you to be ready to own every aspect of your project. You won’t be a newcomer here; you’ll own your thing.

 - Cool vibe. You’re open to constructive criticism and feedback. You’re ready to improve yourself accordingly.

 - Excellent communication skills. You’ll wear multiple hats as you work with marketing artists, product managers, external partners, and your peers within the performance team.

 - Excellent command of English. You’ll manage a creative pipeline that mainly targets the United States audience, and manage joint partnerships with external networks and agencies.


WHAT WE OFFER

· Great Place to Work. As our top team member, you'll be a part of a fast-growing startup and have the privilege to enjoy our accredited “BEST WORKPLACES” environment, ranked first among all workplaces.

· A Competitive Compensation Package. Long story short, we take care of you.

· A Meal Compensation. That is actually enough for a decent & nutritious lunch, we’re not following the industry standard.

· Full Health Benefits. To keep you away from all the trouble, we provide unlimited private health insurance and cover the HPV vaccine.

· Pet Adoption Support. We cover the primary healthcare expenses, parasite vaccinations, and microchip costs that may arise within the first year after employees adopt a pet.

· Cool Tech Stack. Macbook, iPhone 15 Pro, magic mouse, magic keyboard; an adjustable desk with a 4K screen and any other gadget you may need in your job.

· Sport Activities Support. We care about your physical wellbeing and support your gym membership.

· Learning Never Ends! Training budget to help you grow in your role, gain new skills, and learn new things.

· Udemy Free Pass. An unlimited Udemy subscription.

· Flexible Schedule & Unlimited Vacations. This isn’t a “clock in, clock out” company. We care about your productivity, not tracking every minute you’re on site. It’s up to you to always be responsible with your work, no matter where you are or what schedule you’re keeping.

· English Course Support. Be more global and perform best at your work.

· Comprehensive Well-being Support. Through our partnership with Meditopia, we now offer free psychological counseling, along with additional services like dietitian, personal trainer, parenting consultant, physiotherapist, child & adolescent therapist, and face-to-face counseling for employees in Istanbul.

· A Top-Notch Office. Located at the heart of Istanbul, right next to Levent Metro Station at Ferko Signature.

· Codebrew. Yes, you’ve heard it right: We love coffee so much that we’ve built our own coffee shop inside our office, where we also provide healthy snacks at certain hours.

· Free Breakfast. At Codebrew - every morning at 9:30 AM.

· No Dress Code. Dress as you like.

· Happy Hours Every Friday. Every. Single. Friday. When it’s 5 PM: Screens off, party on! (Check out Codeway on Instagram)

· Dream Team. Average Codeway member is young, talented, and passionate - which makes our working environment extremely dynamic. Need proof? Take a look at our Instagram.

· Gaming Area. Whenever you need to take a break from hard work and relax with your favorite games, our PS5 corner will be waiting for you.

· Software Support. Subscription to any software you might need to perform at your best.

· Public Transportation Support. Daily public transportation support is on us, covered by an additional monthly compensation.

· Parent Support. Becoming a parent is a big moment, and Codeway celebrates it with you. We offer a one-time grant to support our new parents.

· Massage Room. When you need a moment to recharge and unwind, our massage chair room will be ready to offer you a relaxing break.



THE RECRUITING PROCESS

We are committed to keeping our recruitment process short and transparent. Here’s how it looks like:

 1. Application: Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You can also just write a few words about yourself.

 2. Case Study: We might send you a task to solve.

 3. Talent & Culture Interview: Let’s talk about your experience & expectations and see what we can achieve together.

 4. Technical Interview: You will meet with future team lead to go over the case and your technical capabilities in detail.

 5. Reference Check: We will contact your references to gain insights into your past experiences and work ethic.

 6. Welcome Aboard! You are now a part of the team.

Title and Summary

Manager, Localization & Transformation, Mastercard Strategic Growth

About the Team

The global payments landscape is undergoing rapid and structural change, driven by geopolitical fragmentation, regulatory activism, and the rise of sovereign digital infrastructure. Governments are playing an increasingly active role in shaping domestic payments ecosystems, redefining competitive dynamics and creating both risk and opportunity for global networks like Mastercard.

The Localization & Transformation team exists in response to this environment. We drive Mastercard’s enterprise-wide commitment to showing up locally and winning domestically (“Domestic Relevance”), ensuring our strategies, solutions, and narratives are credible, competitive, and effective in local markets and with governments.

Within this, the Signals & Localization Readiness team sits at the forefront of anticipating change. The team identifies emerging signals across payments, geopolitics, and technology, translates them into business implications, and enables Mastercard to proactively position for advantage.

Role

This is a high-visibility Manager role at the intersection of analytics, market intelligence, and strategic storytelling.

The role is fundamentally about making sense of a complex, fast-evolving external environment, and shaping how Mastercard understands and responds to it. You will own core strategic products that inform leadership thinking and decision-making.

The role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Mastercard anticipates change, positions itself in markets, and communicates its point of view on the evolving future of payments. Success requires the ability to move fluidly between data, narrative, and judgment: spotting patterns early, structuring ambiguity, and articulating clear implications for the business. This role requires a high degree of ownership across both strategic thinking and execution: taking pride in producing high-quality outputs at every level of detail.

Key Responsibilities

Own Strategic Intelligence Resources
• Own and maintain the team's core intelligence resources, ensuring they remain accurate, current, and aligned to evolving market, policy, and industry developments.
• Oversee the ongoing curation, quality assurance, and enhancement of key datasets that underpin the team's thought leadership, research, and strategic insights.
• Identify emerging trends, gaps, and opportunities within these resources and translate findings into actionable intelligence for stakeholders.
• Partner with colleagues across MA to leverage these resources in reports, publications, presentations, and strategic initiatives.

Produce Thought Leadership & Written Insights
• Support ongoing signals monitoring by tracking external developments across markets, policy, and competitors
• Author high-quality newsletters and insight pieces on the future of payments, geopolitics, and localization trends
• Translate complex concepts into clear, structured, and compelling narratives
• Help shape Mastercard’s internal perspective on market, regulatory, and ecosystem shifts

Own KPI Dashboards & Reporting
• Design, build, and maintain dashboards tracking localization and business performance metrics
• Generate insights, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and clarity for executive audiences

Support Strategy & Execution
• Contribute to strategy development, executive presentations, and playbooks
• Partner with cross-functional and regional teams to drive initiatives forward

Enable Team Effectiveness & Communications
• Support team communications, knowledge management, and content platforms
• Improve processes and ways of working with an entrepreneurial mindset

All About You

Quantitative + Storytelling Strength
• Excel fluency required
• Able to translate data into clear, insightful narratives
• Familiarity with Mastercard internal platforms and databases an advantage

Compelling Writer
• Proven ability to produce crisp, structured, high-quality written content (e.g., newsletters, reports, briefings)
• Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail

Analytical & Curious
• Intellectually curious with the ability to connect business, payments innovation, and global/regulatory dynamics

Entrepreneurial & Hands-On
• Self-starter who can build from scratch, iterate quickly, and “get hands dirty”
• Strong execution mindset in ambiguous environments

Collaborative & Organized
• Team-oriented with a strong sense of shared ownership; willing to lean in to ensure team success

title: Program Manager, Strategy and Operations, Google Arts and Culture
description:
Program Manager, Strategy and Operations, Google Arts and Culture (London, full-time, onsite).

Google Arts and Culture (GAC) is a cross-functional product group whose mission is to preserve, promote, and democratize access to culture. The role bridges GAC leadership, product teams, cross-functional partners and external cultural organizations.

Minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Operations, or equivalent practical experience.
- 2 years of experience in program management, business operations, or strategy and operations, with ownership of end-to-end program lifecycles.
- Experience managing program budgets, financial tracking, and resource allocation (e.g., forecasting, tracking burn rates, agreement milestones).
- Experience defining, tracking, and reporting operational and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs and KPIs) for executive leadership.
- Experience driving cross-functional alignment across technical (engineering/product) and non-technical stakeholders (e.g., partnerships, content, or external institutions).

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in BizOps, central PMO, or strategy and operations within a fast-paced technology company, leading cultural institution, or management consultancy.
- Experience managing complex agreements and strategic external partnerships with global cultural or public institutions.
- Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with proficiency in advanced spreadsheet software, SQL, or dashboarding tools.
- Experience working with emerging technologies (AI/ML, creative tech, digital innovation).
- Exceptional communication skills, including C-level memos and weekly operational updates.

Responsibilities:
- Drive the strategic planning rhythms for GAC: goals, budget planning, allocation and tracking.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Content and Marketing to align priorities and unblock execution.
- Act as the operational contact for external strategic partners (museums, artists, scientific institutions).
- Prepare weekly status reports, budget updates and executive briefs.
- Manage partnerships and program lifecycles, track program metrics, improve tools and processes.
